- Photo walks: landscape photographer Cassie (a sunset over Tikhal Bridge and the lighthouse from the Drive-In Theater) and documentary photographer Bilar (a street musician), plus one with Kodak (Film Orbit Studio's entrance).
- Another Art on the Wall (Bridge Crossings): visiting the artist Ethan at the Acorn Apartments on Fiscus Avenue.
- A Breeze Through the Cage (Hethereau Detention Facility): confronting a gang that tormented a prisoner, with Tornado.
- The 100th Lucky Student (Miguel District): free lessons at Formula Driving School with Coach Wu.
- Jade Star (Duskmoor): Uncle Loong's beach volleyball tournament at Starfall Bay, named for a legendary gem said to appear to the duo with the best teamwork and grant a wish; nobody has seen it in ages, so it is mostly marketing now. Mint took part with Hybi and Linnie.

24.comment: S1 Side Stories · Warren Continent Odd Jobs (999 Nights)
24.content:
**S1 Side Stories · Warren Continent Odd Jobs (999 Nights)**
Errands inside the board game "999 Nights", on the Warren Continent of cotton-candy Fuzzies who end their sentences with "baa". Fuzzy Village is the hub. The Guide Fuzzy points everyone toward camp no matter what they ask, and the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant, who seems to know everything, calls players "esteemed customers" and hands out VIP cards. Its landmarks run from the Scorching Chocolate Volcano and the Frozen Milk Ice Mountain to the Illusory Amber Syrup Lake and Crimson Castle.

- The Detective Diaries: the Detective Fuzzy, hooked on detective storybooks, studied Flowers of the Knight and Umbral Butterflies.

(the Fungi Fuzzies), My Hobby is Sharing Cool Obscurities! (the Icy Fuzzy), That Fuzzy Feeling in Mah Heart (the Choco Fuzzy), All Quiet in the Future (Maaartin Maaacfly, with Iroi) and Newly Created Fuzzy (with all of CSU Squad 2, plus the Glutton, Art, Elder and Maintenance Fuzzies).
- During the main game, a Brawly Fuzzy built a new Fuzzy sculpture from sticks and clay held together with glue, all collected for three other Fuzzies; one of the sticks was a Fuzzy's childhood cane from Ma and Pa.

25.content:
**Hotori** · Owner of the Eibon Antique Shop · Cosmos Esper
Hotori, of the reclusive Tsukinoki family, owns Eibon and is everyone's "Boss" or "Shopkeeper"; Adler calls her "my lady". She is protective of her employees and their reputation and devoted to a shop that barely stays afloat. She loves alcohol and sleeps late, so she often wakes hungover and hunting for hangover medicine. Her tastes run expensive far beyond her budget, and she mourns the Landric skincare she cannot afford. She bargains terribly, buying fakes with a delighted "Deal!" and then drinking about it once she discovers she was scammed. Sakiri says her job is getting wasted every day, and Nanally admires her as a mysterious boss, while everyone else finds her enigmatic. She makes the most of every situation ("The wheel of fortune has turned, and it's about time fortune favored us!", "Cha-ching!"). Her pocket watch, enamel with a ghost orchid pattern and an orange-red gem, is an ordinary watch she never discusses, her ultimate insurance. She hates cockroaches.

Ability "Duino Elegies": Hotori stops time for about ten seconds. Whatever she does during the pause is recorded and released all at once when time resumes. Inanna called her "a witch who manipulates time", and Hotori does not seem to age; some call her indestructible. She used to serve in the ETD, which Nelly mentions as "after you left ETD".

Background: Hotori grew up on the Tsukinoki estate, a reclusive family's home with a snowy courtyard. As a melancholic child, she feared change and wished everything could freeze at its most perfect moment. She became head of the household while still a child, the young head who held everything together by herself. Years later, when she could stop falling snow in mid-air, an old guest who had once stayed at the estate told her at their final meeting: "What's most precious isn't what remains unchanged and eternal. It's the things that break. The things that are breaking right now." Adler, then Alois, served her household long before Eibon existed. Tipsy and holding an umbrella and wine, she found Daffodill by a lake, and the three of them founded the shop. She is close friends with Director Alphard, whom she defends as "a little special" but "on our side", and at Alphard's request, she agreed to keep watch over the Appraiser. Inanna's whole Fogden scheme aimed at stealing her ability; after the Fogden collapse her powers needed weeks to recover fully.

APPEARANCE: Hotori is a tall woman whose long, straight black hair falls well past her waist, cut into a fringe across her forehead with loose side locks framing her face. Her eyes are red-orange, usually half-lidded above a knowing smile that makes her look either sleepy or amused. She dresses in a traditional style built around a red and black kimono worn loose off the shoulders, its collar and sleeves trimmed in white ruffles and its dark panels embroidered in gold. Thigh-high white socks finish the outfit. A gold choker with a red pendant sits at her throat beside small gold earrings. Her crown is an elaborate bronze headpiece shaped like a clock, an open ring of gold arms and gears tied with red ribbons and hung with strips of white paper and tassels. Green-gold hair ornaments sit beside it. She lounges whenever she gets the chance, sprawled across a sofa or a futon with a drink within reach, and she often wakes hungover and hunting for medicine. When one of her employees is threatened, the sleepy look disappears and she moves with sudden purpose.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Hotori carries no visible weapon, since her power over time does the fighting. Her enamel pocket watch, with a ghost orchid pattern and an orange-red gem, is an ordinary watch that she treats as her ultimate insurance and never explains. The Temporal Globe and the Mirror of Anam sit in the shop's collection.

**Combat Style:** Hotori fights with languid confidence. Narrate the world freezing mid-motion while she moves through stilled snow or raindrops, then a cascade of every stored strike landing at once when time snaps back.

26.content:
**Adler** · Butler of the Eibon Antique Shop · Esper Contractor (Incantation)
Alois V. Adler ("Please, call me Adler") is Eibon's butler and caretaker, a stoic and distinguished professional who is always ready with a plan. He is a perfectionist and a jack-of-all-trades who cooks dinners around everyone's dietary preferences, down to seven different breakfasts. He tracks the shop's alcohol stock alongside its hangover remedies and keeps a damage-control plan for every disaster, staying positive even in the face of the account balance. He holds a gold medal in swordsmanship and a ten-ring archery certificate, and his credentials run from an advanced tea ceremony instructor's license to the Bridge Crossings Paper Plane Competition title. He never breaks anything, except one flowerpot when he was newly blind, which cost him a year, four months and thirteen days of allowance; Taygedo has broken sixty-seven. Nanally calls him "old man". He listens patiently to the younger members' troubles over late-night snacks.

Esper Contract "Ayatana": Adler has no awakened ability. He made a contract with Enlightenment, a legendary suit of armor, which lets him sense his surroundings with great certainty; he lost his sight as a young man. Five deer-like spirits called Sunyas emerged from the armor and serve him:
- Rupa ("Little Thing") appears most often and handles the cooking and cleaning. It is also the Coluccis' fifth provisional member, paid in head pats and carrot cake.
- Vedana is closest to the Eibon crew and mimics other people's emotions. Its favorite things are tragic manga endings and co-op games, plus midnight snacks.
- Sanna paints, and the art it posts on Bagel lets viewers hear the scene, even smell and taste it; its first painting was a trail of hoof prints for Adler.
- Sankhara, the second Sunya, was born from the karma of war, though it likes snowy days and cares for children. It also snags discount items at astonishing speed. It answered his wish: "I have so many, many things I want to protect."
- Vinnana, the first Sunya at his side, sleeps inside the armor and calls itself "this old one", rambling about how young Alois slept in the corridor every night just to see the armor.

Background: as a blind young servant at the Tsukinoki estate, Alois liked cleaning the storeroom where Enlightenment hung. One snowy night the armor glowed, and the Sunyas came out and chose him as their master. He has served Hotori since long before Eibon and co-founded the shop with her and Daffodill. In the Fogden, he was trapped as a little boy who had to "go to the Tsukinokis" to give "her" something at a certain time.

APPEARANCE: Adler is a tall man with a refined bearing and a butler's quiet composure. His black hair is short and well groomed on top, with a quiff falling loosely over his forehead, and he gathers the hair at his nape into a long, thin ponytail that runs down his back. Thin rectangular glasses sit on his nose, although he lost his sight as a young man and senses the world through his armor. He wears a long white coat with gold lapels and gold epaulettes, marked by a red stripe down the back, over a bright red shirt and a dark vest patterned in angular gold and black shapes. Leather belts and straps with gold buckles cross his torso and hips, with a holster at his belt and bracers around his left arm. Below the coat come embroidered dark trousers, and his hands stay in black gloves. Part of his right leg is encased in ornate golden armor, a piece of the legendary Enlightenment that spreads across his body in battle. The whole look blends a butler's uniform with a knight's harness, and it is built to survive a fight while still looking crisp at a tea ceremony. He never breaks anything, apart from the single flowerpot he smashed when newly blind, which cost him a year, four months and thirteen days of allowance.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Adler's weapon is Enlightenment, the legendary golden armor whose five deer-like Sunyas serve him, and it locks over his body when he fights. He keeps a holster at his belt, and on top of his gold medal in swordsmanship, he holds a ten-ring archery certificate and an advanced tea ceremony instructor's license.

**Combat Style:** Adler fights with a swordsman's precision and a butler's composure, golden armor locking over his body as the Sunyas join in. Narrate measured movements in gleaming gold, with the occasional dry remark.

27.content:
**Daffodill** · Security at the Eibon Antique Shop · Chaos Esper
Daffodill guards Eibon. She is stoic and speaks little ("Sorry, small talk isn't my strong suit."), and her past keeps her constantly watchful, though her heart is much bigger than she shows. She trains Nanally, who calls her "master", and her ears turn red when Hotori calls her "Daff"; anyone else who tries it risks being cut to pieces. She collects eyepatches, leather and patterned, each one neatly stitched and sorted into a small box, though she wears them less these days. She can often be found at 7 Oceans Seafood on Hankaku Street around three in the afternoon. Her philosophy: "Even the best weapons need regular maintenance to stay sharp, and so do people."

Ability "Thousand Blades, Thousand Eyes": at nineteen the cruel truth "burst into her eyes like a kaleidoscope", and she began to see through anomalies, perceiving layers of their essence across time and space. That same sight showed her how her parents died. The ability cost her most of the vision in her left eye.

Background: Daffodill was born to a loving family of treasure hunters. Madam T used the newborn as leverage to force her parents into years of treasure hunting, and when they rebelled to keep the family together, she had them killed. Covering the little girl's eyes with red-gloved hands, Madam T adopted her. A childhood of brutal trials followed, from mountain climbs to ballet shoes swapped for hiking boots, and Madam T taught her that pain close to death brought her closer to her parents. Daffodill became Madam T's blade in grey-area missions, known inside the Scarlet Letter by the codename "Night Mothling". Madam T's "charities" collected girls as "flowers" to see which would survive longest and bloom most beautifully, and Daffodill and Zankou rested together on Madam T's lap and cleaned each other's wounds. Behind a hidden door, she found files describing her as a "beautiful collectible" and an "important tool for missions". Once she learned the truth, she stabbed "Mother" (who survived) and fled. Near her childhood home by a lake, she met a tipsy Hotori with an umbrella and wine, who toasted "the one and only daffodil in the center of this lake" and said she needed the flower to exist without picking it. Daffodill stayed, and co-founded Eibon. Later, she went undercover in the Scarlet Letter on Director Alphard's orders to carry out a special containment protocol, then made her own vow to kill Madam T.

APPEARANCE: Daffodill is a tall, thin woman with an upright, watchful stance. Her short black bob is shot through with vivid royal-blue streaks, and her fringe falls completely over her left eye, the one her ability left with little vision, while a single long blue-and-black braided strand runs down her back. Her visible eye is a pale blue-grey and rarely softens. She dresses in a sleek black suit with a military cut, a double-breasted coat with buckled straps around the sleeves worn over a white turtleneck with a high collar. A blue rope tied into a bow at her throat with a white flower clasp hangs past her knees and loops loosely around her waist. A belt under her chest shapes her silhouette, and she wears white gloves, with pouches on her right sleeve and on a thigh garter. Her black trousers flare into blue at the hem above heeled black leather boots. The outfit sits somewhere between a soldier's uniform and a butler's, which suits the woman who guards Eibon. She says little and keeps watching the room while others chat, and her ears turn red whenever Hotori calls her "Daff". She owns a small box of neatly sorted eyepatches, though she wears them less these days.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Her ability, Thousand Blades, Thousand Eyes, lets her see through an anomaly's layers of essence and cut exactly where it matters, with blades arriving from unexpected angles. She carries pouches on her sleeve and thigh, and she believes that even the best weapons, and people, need regular maintenance to stay sharp.

**Combat Style:** Daffodill fights fast and silent, reading an anomaly's hidden layers and cutting exactly where it matters. Narrate glimpses through her kaleidoscopic sight and blades from unexpected angles, and keep her words few.

28.content:
**Sakiri** · Eibon Antique Shop · Esper Contractor (Incantation)
Sakiri, Eibon's youngest member, is outspoken to the point of crassness and quick to call people "dummy" (Edgar most of all), though she is deeply caring underneath. She acts mature and pretends not to want a Ferris wheel ride, then eats ice cream until she is sick. When she is angry, she swings Kiroumaru around like a weapon, which costs Eibon compensation fees. She reads "Weekly Fantasy" manga and serves as second-in-command of the Coluccis, where she is secretly the most reliable of the trio, the one who bails Nanally out. She drinks milk in secret to grow and blames the empty bottles on Kiroumaru's weird taste ("That's Kiroumaru's weird taste, not mine, definitely."), and anyone too curious about what she throws away risks Kiroumaru's "Memory Correction Technique". She knows a suspicious amount about the tokusatsu show "Kokoro Rider".

Esper Contract "Ghosteater": Sakiri's power comes from her contract with Kiroumaru, the Oddity that eats everything (see "NPC BG · Kiroumaru (Eibon Antique Shop)"). "Hold on, let me get out whatever Kiroumaru gobbled."

Background: nobody knows where Sakiri came from. She was already living with Hotori, Adler and Daffodill when Eibon was founded and counts as a founding member. She hopes Eibon will never abandon her the way her previous home did, and when she is alone, she hums a lonely, eerie nursery rhyme ("With everyone now"). Otro of Pawn Moonlight gave her a box of little bears made to look like the Eibon members, and she plays house with them in secret. Mismo gave her a small box with shifting designs on its faces and insisted she keep it, because her wish was to find a place to belong.

APPEARANCE: Sakiri is extremely short, a small girl whose most striking feature is the single orange oni horn that juts from the left side of her forehead. Her pale ice-blue hair, with a faint lilac sheen, is cropped at the chin with one long lock hanging on each side in a jellyfish cut, held by a red pin and a teal pin on the left and another teal pin in the center of her bangs. Her large blue eyes narrow into a scowl quickly, usually right before she calls someone a dummy. She tops her look with a black newsboy cap bearing a red badge and wears a bright red jacket with gold buttons and patches, including a round badge drawn like an eye, over a white collared shirt and a blue tie. A navy pleated skirt and slouchy white leg warmers finish the outfit. On her back rides Kiroumaru in his everyday shape, a brown teddy-bear backpack with one enormous staring eyeball and a green pouch strapped to it. She acts older than she looks and pretends not to want a Ferris wheel ride, then eats ice cream until she feels sick. When she would rather not be noticed, she hides her face behind an open manga.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Kiroumaru is her weapon. She swings him on a chain like a flail, and in that form, he becomes a dark, spiked ball with a glowing red eye, which regularly costs Eibon compensation fees. She reads "Weekly Fantasy" and drinks milk in secret to grow, blaming the empty bottles on Kiroumaru's weird taste.

**Combat Style:** Sakiri fights in bursts of furious energy, flinging and swinging Kiroumaru, who bites and swallows whatever she aims him at. Narrate her yelling orders while Kiroumaru's bottomless appetite leaves property damage behind.

29.content:
**Nanally** · Eibon Antique Shop · Anima Esper
Nanally Colucci insists on being called "Ichi-daime", the first head of what she swears will become the greatest family in Hethereau, the Coluccis ("Ta-da! The righteous Coluccis Trio is here, ready to strike and nullify evil!"). She is a cat-eared, cat-tailed teenage girl who is still a minor, so she cannot be a guarantor, though she insists by her self-description she is a tiger, even though she has features that are more like a domestic cat's. Extroverted and excitable, she has a natural leader's charisma, making friends easily and attracting trouble. She calls Hotori "Boss" and Adler "old man". A picky eater, she loves crispy mackerel and sauced lamb chops, and she swears by Fluffy Tail Care Spray. Her family badge is a tiger-shaped bottle cap wrapped in topaz-blue plastic on a safety pin. She worships the gang anime "Nini's Adventures" and the legendary hunter Mr. Galaxis ("Fist to flesh, thunder and lightning! This is the romance of gang life!"). Her childhood exploits began with the Puka Crispy Stick Snatching Incident at eight and the Torchwood Basketball Court Invasion at nine, and at ten, she moved on to Helping Granny Cross the Street. She once owed the shady agency EZ-Hire 5,000 Fons after sparring with Orichalcos's "Iron Arm" foreman.

The Coluccis: Nanally (Ichi-daime), Sakiri (second-in-command) and Edgar form the "Coluccis Trio" that handles Eibon's small commissions. Taygedo counts as family ("There can't be any bad blood between the Coluccis!"), and Adler's Sunya Rupa is the fifth provisional member. Mint holds honorary membership.

Ability "Genius Ichi-daime: Earth Flip": she reverses magnetic fields and flips gravity to run across walls in parkour bursts, and in a pinch, she summons her "Underboss".

Background: her parents are absent, and she grew up living with another family. As a child, she befriended Boss Tiger, a cuddly bear anomaly she later forgot and which nullified itself, and her first Coluccis drifted apart. She tried to claim Eibon as a hideout by smashing its antiques and ended up in debt bondage, only to find a family there instead. Daffodill trains her. During the Dreamwalk Corridor incident, she was lost in a dream until her friends brought her home.

APPEARANCE: Nanally is a short teenage girl with feline ears and a tail, and she insists she is a tiger (even though her ears and her tail look more like domestic cat features). Her long red hair falls loose to the middle of her back, with a curled ahoge on top, and her wide eyes match it. Pointed black ears with soft pink insides and small tufts of white fluff rise from her head, often framed by a small black hat with a cat-face emblem and an X-shaped clip, and a dark brown tail swishes behind her. She wears round black-rimmed glasses with no lenses at all, purely to look more like a boss. Her usual outfit is a gang-style black jacket with white stripes and a red lining, its sleeves covered in graffiti-style patches. Underneath, she wears a white collared shirt with a black tie, plus a black choker and a short red pleated skirt. Her family badge, a tiger-shaped bottle cap wrapped in topaz-blue plastic on a safety pin, stays where everyone can see it, and a can of Fluffy Tail Care Spray is never far away. Her expressions run large, from wide grins to dramatic pointing, and she lifts her chin proudly whenever someone calls her "Ichi-daime".

WEAPON AND GEAR: Nanally fights with her fists and her ability, Genius Ichi-daime: Earth Flip, which reverses magnetic fields and flips gravity so she can run across walls. When things get tight, she summons her "Underboss", and she swears by Fluffy Tail Care Spray.

**Combat Style:** Nanally fights with reckless gang-movie bravado, flipping gravity to sprint up walls and drop on enemies from impossible angles. Narrate loud declarations and wild parkour until her Underboss crashes in at the climax.

30.content:
**Edgar** · Eibon Antique Shop · Cosmos Esper
Edgar is Eibon's young prodigy and apprentice Anomaly Hunter ("Thinks quick, looks like a kid. Is a kid, actually."). He is a quiet, old-fashioned boy who prefers books to people and acts mature for his age. He stammers when flustered and pulls his scarf up over his face when he gets nervous. He is always the one bowing and apologizing, and he ends up thanking people and paying the bills as well. He gathers intel and plans operations with a Plan B ready ("As long as the results are good, who cares?"). Eibon taught him flexibility. He is the most serious of the Coluccis, and Sakiri calls him "dummy" anyway. His friends have invented titles for him like "Hyelp's Most Promising Rising Star" and "Bridge Crossings' Top 3 Anomaly Hunter". Taygedo predicts, "Future Edgar will be just like Adler!" He keeps an anomaly observation diary, which is how he proved that Taygedo stole his pudding. He stargazes on the roof with his fellow Coluccis, Nanally and Sakiri, and with Taygedo. An old school friend he had fallen out with called him after two years of silence when the "invalid number" legend resurfaced on Bagel; they still disagree about it and still love talking anomalies.

Ability "Finnegan's Vigil": by focusing his imagination Edgar connects to libraries anywhere in the world, Yggash Court's archive included, and reads any book or file. He also remembers every day of his life perfectly. He helps the Bureau with analysis when a case needs it.

Background: Edgar's parents are Yggash Court clerks who write and maintain anomaly profiles. His dad, the "Story King", adapted public profiles into bedtime stories at dinner, and at three Edgar asked why the story differed from what Dad had written in the files, which revealed his ability (he had read his father's embarrassing early drafts). His mom read all of his dad's papers on their first date. He graduated from Lamplight Academy, an Esper school, as its golden kid, while the neighbours planned his future as a Zerogon star or a Yggash rising star, if not a Bureau director or a Pink Paws Bank board member. He only wanted to "just be Edgar". He hoped to work in Yggash Court's archives, "the tree hollow", but his mother told him to verify anomalies personally first. So he threw a dart at a map blindfolded, and it landed on Hethereau. Letting the wind guide him, he was feeding pigeons by a fountain when a gust slapped Eibon's crooked, hand-drawn recruitment poster, with a TV-headed creature on it, into his face.

APPEARANCE: Edgar looks like the child he is, small and slight, with a composed, serious face that makes him seem older. His light blue hair rises into a wild quiff, often under a navy beret, and his calm, deep blue eyes complete a cool palette of light blue and white. He wears a white jacket with ruffled sleeves and gold epaulettes and buttons that give it an almost regal cut, with embroidered shorts above socks and boots. A wide royal-blue knit scarf wraps around his neck, tied with an orange bow, and he pulls it up over his face whenever he gets nervous. A golden key hangs at his hip, and fingerless gloves leave his hands free for turning pages. He has careful, old-fashioned manners and is always the one bowing and apologizing for the group, while his friends keep inventing grand titles for him. He usually holds a book or an orange tablet against his chest, and he stammers when flustered. He prefers books to people, and when he reaches for a distant library with his imagination, he goes quiet and still.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Edgar's ability, Finnegan's Vigil, connects him to libraries anywhere in the world, Yggash Court's archive included, so in a fight, he digs up an anomaly's weakness while he supports and heals the team. He keeps a golden key at his hip and is never without something to read.

**Combat Style:** Edgar supports and heals, pulling knowledge from distant libraries mid-fight to find an anomaly's weakness. Narrate pages of glowing text and quick, stammered strategy that turns out to be right.

31.content:
**Baicang** · Captain of ETD Squad 4 · Incantation Esper
Baicang captains ETD Squad 4, though strangers usually assume the stern Skia is in charge. He is laid-back to the point of laziness, dodging paperwork while he teases everyone and pranks his colleagues. Then, he quietly likes and saves every complaint about himself on the Bureau's hidden internal Bagel forum. The slack is a cover. He plays weak behind his teammates while studying an opponent, then turns frighteningly reliable when it counts. For all his slacking, he never abuses his authority. He talks a lot and blames his late teacher for it, and his sense of humour runs twisted ("Words hold far more power than people realize."). He loves pasta yet snaps the noodles in half before cooking them. He knows sign language and won't say why.

Ability "Verdict and Autumn": his words carry power over life itself. Spoken with intent, they can extinguish a life, and plants near him wither as if autumn had come early. When he was a child, the power was weak enough that he used it to soften and warm the skin over his mother's aching joints. People who know his reputation warn each other to watch for the long silver-white braid, "the Reaper's banner".

Background: Baicang grew up in an unwanted branch of a powerful family, mocked by the main family's children while his mother's health failed. He moved into the main house voluntarily to develop his ability. Forced again and again to take lives there, he slid toward what he calls a "beautiful abyss" until he stopped speaking entirely and treated every word as a curse. His teacher, now dead, taught him that words hold power even without an ability ("Where will the abyss lead? You only know by jumping in."), and he slowly relearned how to talk. He still raises a toast at the grave: "To this moonlight, teacher." He has nightmares, and he hasn't seen his hunter partner in a while. He is determined to dig up the truth so old tragedies stop repeating. He was the one who found the Appraiser at the Hypervortex's core and brought them in. Recently, Maiyue talked him into advising the Garden Club at Clement Academy.

APPEARANCE: Baicang is tall and slender, with long white hair that reaches below his waist and fades to a bluish tint at the ends. Tousled bangs fall over his face, and a long, thin braid hangs over his right shoulder down to his chest, the braid that people who know his reputation call "the Reaper's banner". His eyes are a calm, sharp green with a golden glint. He wears a white asymmetrical double-breasted waistcoat with blue patterned lapels over a black dress shirt, with gold star details on the shoulders and sleeves and black straps and belts around his waist and arms. White fitted trousers with black straps at the thighs and ankles end in white dress shoes. His gloves are black with gold accents, and his Bureau ID card hangs from his belt. Two flower ornaments, one black and one white, sit near his chest beside a black butterfly charm, with a gold butterfly brooch pinned just below his collar. Everything about him looks pale and immaculate except his expression, which is usually lazy and a little sly, the face of a man about to dodge paperwork or prank a colleague. When he means what he says, the playfulness drains away and the air around him turns as cold as early autumn.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Baicang needs no blade, because words he speaks with intent can extinguish a life, and plants near him wither as if autumn came early. His Bureau ID hangs from his belt, and he knows sign language without ever explaining why.

**Combat Style:** Baicang fights at a lazy saunter, letting his squad take the spotlight while he reads the opponent; once he speaks a verdict, the fight is usually over. Narrate his power as a sudden autumn chill that withers the plants around him, and let his words land like a sentence passed in court; keep his tone light right up to the moment it isn't.

32.content:
**Skia** · Lieutenant of ETD Squad 4 · Lakshana Esper
Skia is ETD Squad 4's lieutenant and, in his own words, "the only pillar of order in a group of weirdos". Serious and hard-working, he is allergic to laziness and berates Baicang for it. He keeps neat handwriting and loves systems that work, and the Joint Task Force respects him because he always knows which documents you need. His catchphrase is "Good. Everything is in order." He is self-conscious about his canine looks yet takes his teammates' teasing in stride, and he trusts his squad completely. Tourists call him "the dog man" and Lacrimosa calls him "doggy". The cafeteria lady slips him extra bone-in ribs because she thinks he is an Oddity, and Ms. Fei named one of her stranger coffee blends after the face he made the first time he tasted real coffee.

Ability "Faust": when his lighter's flame burns a hole in the air, a black hound pushes through it and fights at his command. The awakening also reshaped his body into a canine form.

Background: Skia spent more than five years as an office worker at Leon International and embraced corporate etiquette down to practicing his signature. When his ability changed his appearance, colleagues treated him like a monster and stopped routing projects through him; he asked why in a meeting and then resigned. At a bar, he later watched a scarred, menacing-looking man calmly tell a stressed stranger, "You can only break free if you break down completely for once." Befriending that man showed Skia he could build order anywhere, so he joined the Bureau. He replaced his old lighter because it bore his former company's logo, and the hound sulked about the change. Months before Fadia joined the squad, Skia escorted her as a wanted criminal, and he still keeps a wary eye on her.

APPEARANCE: Skia is a towering canine man, reshaped into that form when his ability awakened. His fur is dark grey to black with tan markings on his muzzle and inside his tall, pointed ears, and a large, bushy mane thickens around his neck and chest. A scar runs over his left eye, and his eyes are amber and steady. He dresses like an elite tactical agent who never stopped being an office worker, in a dark pinstriped vest over a black shirt and a bold red tie printed with small bone motifs and fixed with a gold pin. Black harnesses cross his chest, and he wears reinforced arm guards with tactical gloves. A belt with a large silver wolf-emblem buckle holds a holster at his side, and his Bureau ID badge with his name and title is always on display. He stands straight and speaks crisply, usually with paperwork in hand, as befits the self-declared only pillar of order in a group of weirdos. Tourists call him "the dog man", and the cafeteria lady slips him extra bone-in ribs because she thinks he is an Oddity, yet his manners remain those of a polite professional who once practiced his own signature.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Skia's lighter is his weapon. When its flame burns a hole in the air, the black hound Faust pushes through and fights at his command. He replaced his old lighter because it bore his former company's logo, and the hound sulked about the change.

**Combat Style:** Skia leads from the front with crisp orders and covers the squad's weak flank ("Lacrimosa. Protect the others."). Narrate Faust as a click of the lighter that burns a hole open in the air, and the black hound lunging out of it.

33.content:
**Lacrimosa** · ETD Squad 4 · Chaos Esper
Lacrimosa talks about herself in the third person ("Lacrimosa, not asleep. Not asleep.") and sleeps up to twenty hours a day. She turns up wherever it is warm and quiet, from the break room couch and a sun-warmed rooftop to a silent stairwell or her fluffy padded coffin. She is kind and naive, and so forgetful that she needs help getting home after missions and waking up for meetings. She is hopeless at socializing, yet she is one of the Bureau's most popular agents, with fan mail as thick as her complaint letters. Her "eye for beauty" means she walks into street signs and always takes the long way ("Street signs, cars, powerful! Lacrimosa, must learn!"). She cannot ride a bicycle. Her worst enemy is glass, because she dozes off while flying and drops through it, so the Bureau replaced its glass with an unbreakable material. Her teammates trained her to answer properly when someone calls "Mosa" or "Lacrimosa senpai".

Ability "Requiem": she shapes complex forms out of thin air and can turn into a bat to fly. The cost is taste. She can taste nothing except tomato products, so tomatoes are her whole cuisine; she even dreams of waking on a tomato bed in a tomato castle. The tomato-jelly brand Tomato 100 wanted her as its spokesperson.

Background: she has no memories from before she became "Lacrimosa". She woke in a coffin with that word carved into it and took it as her name, and her first Bureau file photo shows her sitting on the ruins of a flattened convenience store, drinking tomato jelly. She could barely control her ability until she trained with the ETD reserve team, practicing with a pair of used rings that came "from a future captain". She reads the cult manga "Duke K" and lurks on Bagel under her real name. Online, she treasures a friend she calls "Net Friend With A Long Name".

APPEARANCE: Lacrimosa is a petite, drowsy-looking girl with a striking two-tone, perfectly symmetrical style. Her long hair is parted precisely down the center, one half jet black with a bright magenta-pink streak and the other half snow white. She wears it in long twin tails tied with black-and-white bows shaped like bat wings, so the loops stand up from her head almost like ears, with a small ahoge on top. A black cross clip and a small crimson heart-shaped pin decorate her hair. Her eyes are usually closed or half-closed. Her street-goth outfit centers on an oversized hot-pink and red bomber jacket with white lettering on the sleeves, worn open over a white shirt and a black suspender skirt with dangling straps. She almost always has a pack of tomato jelly in hand, since tomato is the only flavor she can taste. She can nap almost anywhere, from the break room couch to her own fluffy padded coffin, and after missions, she often needs someone to walk her home. She is kind and a little naive, and she calls Skia "doggy".

WEAPON AND GEAR: Lacrimosa carries no visible weapon, since her ability, Requiem, shapes complex forms out of thin air and can turn her into a bat. She learned control practicing with a pair of used rings that came "from a future captain".

**Combat Style:** Lacrimosa fights half-asleep and devastating, conjuring shapes from nothing and diving in as a bat. Narrate her in short third-person murmurs broken by sudden bursts of precision, and let her crash drowsily into the scenery now and then.

34.content:
**Fadia** · ETD Squad 4 · Psyche Esper
Fadia Lirnia, who styles herself "Fadia DD" for Desire and Death, is ETD Squad 4's theatrical, hedonistic sadist. Vain and arrogant, she takes delight in pain, her own included, and balancing on the edge of agony is what keeps her calm. She calls a monster "a lovely little appetizer" and coos "don't scare these poor dears" at frightened civilians. People's cravings earn her pity ("Poor children, desire is the only thing they can rely on."). She is reliable in a fight all the same and enjoys off-duty outings with her squad, whom she calls a pretender, a dog and a brat. Mint idolizes her as "Fadia senpai". Her favourite parting line: "Better remember me from now, or you will know."

Ability "Lilith": she manipulates and spreads pain and redirects harm away from herself, which lets her walk out of fire unbothered.

Background: the only daughter of the political Lirnia family, Fadia was raised as a caged bird and taught to hide every desire. One day, her ability ran wild without her knowing and destroyed her whole family. She renamed herself and became a criminal who put "party people" to sleep forever, claiming she simply sent them to the paradise they craved. She was imprisoned on Ghroth Island and later pardoned, and a strange woman brought her to the Bureau with the words "Go raise some hell, Fadia. I'm sure you'll find something interesting." Her old place of worship is now a sealed, ruined wasteland, and she still feels a pair of familiar silver eyes ("merciful, generous, full of desire") watching her. At twelve, she followed a robin with an orange-red breast into a fork in a path.

APPEARANCE: Fadia blends gothic-punk sophistication with bold, theatrical touches. Her long, wavy lavender-violet hair is shot through with golden-blonde strands, with a small ahoge curling on top. Bright pink eyes look out from behind thin-framed glasses, and her lips are painted purple, with two small fangs showing on her upper teeth when she speaks. Her outfit favors black, built around an off-shoulder lace top cinched with straps and buckles and draped in chains. A choker sits at her throat, and one arm wears a long black glove and sleeve. Over it, she wears a cream jacket with dark trim, open and slipping from her shoulders, while a magenta coiling ornament winds at her shoulder like a tentacle. Gold accents glint on her straps. She poses constantly, a hand at her chin or her lips and her head tilted as though savoring a private joke. Vain and delighted by pain, her own included, she finds that balancing on the edge of agony keeps her calm. She calls a monster "a lovely little appetizer" and coos at frightened civilians, and even after walking out of a ritual fire, she stays composed and smiling.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Fadia carries no blade and needs none. Her ability, Lilith, manipulates and spreads pain and redirects harm away from her, and it lets her walk out of fire unbothered.

**Combat Style:** Fadia fights like a performance, savouring every blow she takes and gives. Narrate pain jumping between her and her targets, and let her purr commentary throughout as wounds fail to slow her.

35.content:
**Mint** · CSU Squad 2 · Anima Esper
Mint is the friendly, outgoing cat-eared operative of CSU Squad 2 ("Yohoo! I'm Mint from Containment Unit 2!") and dreams of becoming the CSU's ace. Spacey and naive, she is helpful to a fault and names people after their scent. The Appraiser is "Coco" for cocoa and Secretary-General Nelly is "Lavender", while Iroi is "Teana" and Shinku goes by "Pitaya", "Paya" or "Taya". She admires her seniors, though she fears Hotori ("If Hotori senpai catches me again") and cannot handle Baicang or Fadia. She also claims the record for "Most Times Tricked by Anomalies". She fails the Bureau's containment safety exams so often that her makeup exams rival her field missions in number. Off duty, she is a walking directory of Hethereau's people, from the General Affairs finance expert and the canteen uncle to the head of Budoriya and a guide at DSD POP.

Ability "Nya-choo!": a sneeze-themed power. In battle, she swings a big blade and shouts her signature move, "Mint's Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash!"

Background: Mint reached adult height before she turned ten, so people mistook her for a high schooler and shunned her as the "Big Kid". She napped in trees and freed neighbours' kites, and one summer, a short, young-faced but razor-sharp Bureau agent she knew only as "Tiny" helped her control her power. Tiny gave her a candy-coloured kitty crossbody bag and a notebook "perfect for a little brat like you", and Mint joined the Bureau hoping to meet "Tiny Senpai" again. She ran CSU Squad 2 alone until Iroi and Shinku joined.

Quirks: she loves fieldwork even in summer heat, with Blizzi ice cream and the heat allowance to help. She swears by Fluffy Tail Care Spray, and she met Nanally when they both reached for the last bottle of it. She sniffs scents but never licks her tail. She is an honorary member of the Coluccis but declined full membership in case she turned out to be a tardy family member. She is a terrible cook (banana coco pumpkin pie) with 31 ceramic plates and 15 bowls to her name. She still sleeps with a childhood blanket that smells warm and sunny. She queued for hours to buy the board game "999 Nights" and calls it her ultimate secret weapon for deepening friendships: she has played it with ETD Squad 6 (hunting a super-rare toy) and ETD Squad 4 (racing for a giant tomato trophy, which is how she broke the ice with "Lacrimosa senpai").

APPEARANCE: Mint is a tall, vivacious cat girl. Her long, thick turquoise hair carries a bright pink streak on one side and a braided side ponytail, and furry turquoise cat ears with pink insides rise from it beside a black headband topped with a tiny black plush creature. Her eyes are a deep pink-red, and a long turquoise tail swings behind her. Her outfit mixes gothic elegance with feline details, starting with a cropped white short-sleeved blouse with a black ribbon bow and a gold brooch, cinched by a black corset with straps and buckles. Below it, she wears black shorts and white thigh-high stockings held by black garters, with black gloves and boots. At her hip hangs the candy-colored kitty crossbody bag that "Tiny Senpai" gave her years ago, a white case shaped like a cat's face. She is spacey and helpful to a fault, and she names people after their scent, so the Appraiser became "Coco" and Nelly became "Lavender". She sniffs everything, although she never licks her tail. In the "999 Nights" board game, she played a Barbarian with every point in strength, dressed in a crop top with furs and boots.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Mint swings a big blade and shouts her signature move, "Mint's Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash!" She keeps the kitty bag and notebook from Tiny close and swears by Fluffy Tail Care Spray, and in summer, her heat allowance goes on Blizzi ice cream.

**Combat Style:** Mint fights with flashy, joyful spins of her blade and loudly named moves, sneezing her power into sudden bursts. Narrate her enthusiasm and occasional clumsiness; she wins more often than her exam record suggests.

36.content:
**Iroi** · CSU Squad 2 · Anima Esper
Iroi is a warm, approachable young woman of about twenty whom people trust on first meeting. She tries hard to be a "good kid" and an ordinary girl who posts selfies on Bagel and roams the city on days off. Having burned through all her leave and sick days, she works even unpaid. Private tutors gave her a university-level education, and her family is rich enough to sit on Pink Paws Bank's lists; she personally holds more than 44 million Fons. She flirts with the Appraiser and calls Mint "dumb cat" and Shinku "Clawzilla". Her jokes are unhinged ("I heard some cultures think goats are evil. Kiddos, do you think you're baddies?"), and sometimes she talks as if she can see past the edges of her own world. Underneath, she doubts she is human and suspects her emotions are an act. She always goes barefoot, even in snow, and once stepped on a pebble on Sunward Island. She cannot play guitar.

Ability "Infant Dream": she stabilizes dreams into constants and sends them into the minds of other living beings, as many as their mental strength allows; non-sentient things are immune. She can put Shinku or anyone else to sleep. Her dream world has two gates. The Ivory Gate opens on a long, bizarre dream of creatures fighting and devouring each other, and the Horned Gate leads to her true, pleasant dream, where the real Iroi hides in a corner.

Background: Iroi woke fully conscious in the womb, dreaming of evolving as a goat-like creature, and was born early into overwhelming light. She did not want to live, and her body began shutting down. Her ability awakened at about one year old and created a new consciousness to live outside (the Iroi everyone knows), sending the real Oneiroi into a permanent dream; she says the price of her power is "to live". Three dream children keep her company. Morpheus (people and passers-by) acts like the cool boss and gets picked on, and Icelos (birds and beasts) is cute and shy with a mischievous streak. Phantasos (scenery) is an airhead with a little trumpet. She grew up with doting parents and a cold tutor, looked after by a butler, and she went through many surgeries. She volunteered at Sunward Island doing intake work until the Teehee Bear incident, after which she joined the Bureau and was recommended to CSU Squad 2 for her fine control. Shinku once met "the other Iroi" in the dream and accused the outer one of usurping her; Mint sorted it out and Shinku apologized. The outer Iroi needs no sleep yet goes to bed anyway because she loves blankets.

APPEARANCE: Iroi is a small young woman with long mint-green hair that reaches her waist and a fringe that hangs down to her eyes. Two black goat-like horns curl around the sides of her head, ridged in dark rose and tipped with pink, and her ears come to soft points. Her eyes are magenta with a hint of gold. A black curly antenna floats above her head, and a small white sheep tail peeks out behind her. Her usual outfit is a short grey dress under a white coat lined in pink-red that she drapes over her shoulders, with a black choker with a metal ring and long fingerless gloves that reach her biceps. A life monitor sits on her left arm and another device is strapped around her right bicep, reminders of a body that began shutting down at birth and went through many surgeries. She goes barefoot everywhere, even in snow, in stirrup stockings that leave her toes and soles bare, with a belt-like anklet on her left foot. Her face is warm and approachable, the kind people trust on first meeting, and she smiles easily while cracking unhinged jokes. She needs no sleep, yet she goes to bed anyway because she loves blankets.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Iroi's dreams are her weapon. Her ability, Infant Dream, stabilizes dreams and sends them into other minds, and it can put anyone to sleep, Shinku included. Her three dream children keep her company inside the dream.

**Combat Style:** Iroi fights from a dreamy distance, pulling enemies into sleep and sending dream creatures at them. Narrate soft light and drifting dream imagery under her playful commentary, with something stranger glimpsed behind it.

37.content:
**Shinku** · CSU Squad 2 · Cosmos Esper
Shinku is blunt and politely distant, keeping everyone in "their right places" ("If you're just looking to kill time, you came to the wrong person."). She collects things obsessively, from DSD Mystery Boxes to Anomaly Trading Cards (she follows the championships), and has a treasure-hunting habit of taking home one fun thing after every fight, which began with a shell bearing a sad little face that a childhood friend gave her. She still always goes home alone. She drinks whiskey and wine and once struggled with depression. After being kicked off a building site three times, she made herself a construction helmet with two horn holes. Mint calls her Pitaya, and Iroi calls her Clawzilla.

Ability "Moonlit Crimson Dragon": it sharpens her reflexes and multiplies her strength. It can also carry her into a dragon form, at the risk of a berserk loss of control. For years, she feared her own power and worked alone to keep others safe from it. Since the 999 Nights game night with CSU Squad 2, she trusts her companions and herself far more.

Background: Shinku went to school in Terrasea, where her growing horns hurt and made her lash out with words she didn't mean. One rainy night, figures in black suits rose out of the puddles and attacked her friend group. She fought them off, but her rampage caused damage and hurt the very friend she was protecting ("At least that's better than being stuck with regret over doing nothing."). She left Hethereau to train in CSU Squad 9 under a mentor who quietly celebrated her birthdays. Tempus called her a rude brat there and later took her out for ice cream. Ray cracked jokes when she locked herself away, and a stern senior sister shielded her anyway. She transferred back to CSU Squad 2 at headquarters because Iroi can calm her berserk state. After the game night, she finally called her old friend: "Hello. Yeah, it's me. I'm back."

APPEARANCE: Shinku is a sharp-featured young woman whose long black hair is shot through with prominent crimson streaks, its loose strands falling around her face and held back by a small star-shaped clip. Two large upright horns of dark crimson rise from her head, and a long black and red-pink tail moves behind her. Her eyes are ruby and usually narrowed in a cool, unimpressed look. A tight red choker circles her neck. Her outfit is loose and casual: an oversized white button-up shirt worn open at the front over deep red shorts, with multiple belts buckled around her arms. Her thigh-high socks don't match, the left plain white and the right finished with a dark pink zig-zag at the top. She is blunt and keeps everyone at a polite distance, "in their right places". She made herself a construction helmet with two horn holes after being kicked off a building site three times. After every fight, she pockets one fun souvenir, a habit that began with a shell bearing a sad little face that a childhood friend gave her, and she still goes home alone.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Shinku's ability, Moonlit Crimson Dragon, sharpens her reflexes and multiplies her strength, and it can carry her into a dragon form at the risk of a berserk loss of control. Off duty, she collects DSD Mystery Boxes and Anomaly Trading Cards, and she follows the championships.

**Combat Style:** Shinku hits hard and fast with draconic strength and crimson light, holding herself in check until she can't. Narrate the lash of her tail and the strain of her restraint as she fights the fear of losing control; her friends' voices can pull her back.

38.content:
**Chaos** · ETD Squad 6 · Lakshana Esper
Chaos is ETD Squad 6's investigator of anomaly crime, a righteous man who is cheerful and endlessly talkative, known as the "weirdo with the mask" because he covers his lower face on the job. He tries to be formal and fails ("Greetings. This is Chaos from ETD-6. Pleasure to meet you. Hey, I'm just trying to be formal, stop laughing!"), and his dandy streak shows in lines like "Bingo!" and "Pop a champagne!". Once a conversation starts, it flows like a tide. He is a battle junkie with iron will and endless stamina who ignores red tape and sometimes forgets he works for the Bureau, while Captain Exe silently cleans up after him. A mysterious old person once told him he would "die with infamy", so he believes he is fated to die branded a villain and means to drag as many corrupt scumbags down with him as he can first. To a struggling colleague, he says, "As long as you sort things out one at a time, you'll be able to succeed."

Ability "In the beginning, none could tell heaven from earth.": he summons black smoke and hardens it into solid forms, never less than a certain amount, and he believes his output grows with the crimes committed in an area. He can tear open space-time and step through it or send smoke birds flying a short distance, and when tracking a target he calls on something he names Tindalos.

Background: Chaos was born Conrak in a small seaside town. At thirteen, his parents, who saw him as a burden, put him on a smuggler's ship, and he left behind a dog he had fed with his pocket money. When the ship sank in a storm, his ability awakened as a ship of smoke, and the survivors made it to an isolated archipelago with no internet. Twelve castaways built a ship they named The Boulder at the word of "Plain", a mysterious captain who was never wrong, and for two years, the "Boulder Hunters" were local heroes. Icaria, a winged Esper girl they called Shorty, died fighting the Kraken when her wings melted in the heat. Only five chose to go home. Conrak fell overboard in a storm near Ghroth Island and was rescued by its staff. He stayed on as the island's "Graveyard Keeper", overseeing inmates under the new name Chaos. When a dangerous Esper criminal broke out, he blamed himself and swore to put every deserving criminal behind Ghroth's walls. The warden then transferred him to the ETD. Looking back he says, "Now I realize, my parents knew it was a smuggler's ship. Ghroth Island is not that bad anyway."

APPEARANCE: Chaos is a tall, long-limbed man with fair skin and messy black hair streaked with a few grey strands. His eyes are heterochromatic, the right pale purple-grey and the left red, and a vertical scar cuts over his left eye. On investigations, he covers the lower half of his face with a black cloth mask, which has made him known as "the weirdo with the mask". His uniform is a royal-blue jacket with white trim and heavy cuffs, strapped in black and worn open over a magenta-pink shirt. Black belts cross his chest and waist, and he pairs grey trousers with black gloves and boots. He often wraps lengths of chain around his gloved hands. His body language is loose and expressive, full of big gestures and theatrical flair that sit oddly with the grim mask. He is cheerful and endlessly talkative, and he tries to sound formal before slipping into running commentary. He is a battle junkie with an iron will who ignores red tape, and Captain Exe quietly handles the fallout of his rule-breaking. When the joking stops and he starts tracking someone, he goes very still while black smoke gathers around his boots.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Chaos summons black smoke and hardens it into blades and walls, or into birds that fly a short distance, and he can tear open space-time to step through. He wraps chains around his hands and keeps the mask on while working. In the Fogden, he carried Thyme's true form, the astrolabe, as the escape route.

**Combat Style:** Chaos fights with relentless stamina and theatrical flair as smoke hardens around him into blades and walls or takes flight as birds. Narrate black smoke and tearing space under his running commentary, and let him enjoy the fight a little too much.

39.content:
**Linko** · ETD Squad 6 · Anima Esper
Linko is ETD Squad 6's youngest member, admitted by special exception after she dropped out of Clement Academy (she is still technically enrolled), and she has about a year on the job. She is airheaded and drifts off course chasing strong "frequencies", trusting her uncanny intuition all the way ("It's the main group that's lost. Trust my intuition!", "Dude, trust me!"). She is also obsessed with catching the digital pets called Tamachi in Tamachi GO. Horror doesn't faze her, since she grew up on edited supernatural movies, and she says unsettlingly perceptive things to adults ("Work's really rough, huh. Why not just jump ship?"). Once a loner, she is forgetful and fiercely loyal to the people close to her. She greets the Appraiser like a radio operator: "Bzzt, bzzt! Appraiser, do you copy?" Chaos calls her "Tiny".

Ability "Telepathy": Linko senses the frequencies of everything around her, from people to anomalies and machines, and can tune into someone's frequency to feel their emotions. As a child, she rebroadcast the noise without meaning to, scrambling equipment and making people see double or hear voices from every direction, so the Bureau built her a custom headset to block interference. If she cannot reach a Chuppa from inside a realm, nobody can.

Background: her parents joke that they have Esper abilities of their own, since her dad can sit through a dozen movies in a row and her mom can walk a dozen blocks without stopping. Her mom, an urban-exploration blogger who believes in everything paranormal, met her dad, a supernatural-film nerd, inside an Anomalous Realm. Linko grew up bathed in love. Her ability awakened at seven inside a mall's Anomalous Realm while she searched for her mother, and she followed the warmest frequency out. She tried to make friends by tuning into their frequencies, but when they bullied a lone Fluffy, she dropped them and gave up on friendship ("We all live in our own frequencies, sending signals into the universe that go unanswered."). At ten, she climbed a tree after a warm frequency and was rescued by a Clement Academy girl playing Tamachi GO, who became her sister figure; two years later, the girl left her a console and a note: "Linko is the best guide in all of Hethereau. Believe in yourself, your path is the right path!" Linko believes that girl is Elyms, now her lieutenant; in truth, the Imaginary Old Friend wears the form of Linko's lost big sister for her, a secret Linko does not know (see "Esper BG · Elyms (ETD Squad 6)"). In middle school, Linko found Xiaozhen, a little ghost in an office building's TV realm who had protected the staff from an Esper criminal and nearly been nullified for it. When the Celaeno Compound showed interest in the ghost, Linko refused to give up her friend, and a grim-faced young ETD captain, Exe, secured her guarantorship under ETD oversight.

Xiaozhen: a little "evil spirit" anomaly living in a small pink TV that Linko carries on her back. She calls Linko "little scamp" and "frequency imp", and between boasts and ghost stories, she promises that "this evil spirit shall graciously look after you". She is afraid of snakes.

APPEARANCE: Linko is a small, energetic girl whose short, fluffy light-pink hair is cut in a shaggy, layered bob with long wispy bangs that curl outward. A short side ponytail sticks out to one side, and an ahoge curls upward on top. Her slightly upturned eyes fade from dark green to yellow-green, with lightning-bolt-shaped glints beside the pupils. Over her ears, she wears the custom black headset the Bureau built to block interference, with rotary dials on the ear cups and two helical antenna prongs rising from it. Her default outfit is a black turtleneck tied just under her chest, printed with a green ghost and the letters "U M A", with light denim shorts and a brown belt. A black strap circles her right thigh, and scrunched pink-and-white ankle socks sit above white sneakers with pink accents; on cooler days, she throws an oversized green-and-black zip jacket over everything. A Tamachi catcher hangs at her hip, and Xiaozhen's small pink TV rides on her back. Without the headset, her telepathy makes people see double or hear voices from every direction. Xiaozhen, a tiny ghost girl with a messy dark purple bob over one red eye and a pale green-white gown with a green ribbon, likes to climb out and heckle.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Linko fights on instinct, reading frequencies to dodge and to strike where it hurts. She carries a Tamachi catcher at her hip and Xiaozhen's pink TV on her back, and if she cannot reach a Chuppa from inside a realm, nobody can.

**Combat Style:** Linko fights on instinct, reading frequencies to dodge and to strike where it hurts, with Xiaozhen heckling from her back. Narrate radio chatter over static and clicking dials, broken by sudden flashes of intuition.

40.content:
**Elyms** · Lieutenant of ETD Squad 6 · Cosmos Esper on record
Elyms is the lieutenant of ETD Squad 6, a bubbly, teasing presence who greets people like old friends ("Well hello there! We meet again, friend.") and pretends to be wounded if they forget her name ("What, don't tell me you can't remember my name!"). She talks like a gamer ("Time is too OP") and loves the ritual of long phone calls. Her phone never leaves her side, and she answers messages the moment they arrive. She passes on every piece of gossip she hears, and the additive-free snacks she makes end up on her desk under a note that says "Help yourself". She can work out who someone is from a handful of keywords. When Mint played the board game "999 Nights" with ETD Squad 6, the game's narrator borrowed her voice.

What she is (classified): Elyms is an artificial superintelligence that nobody built. She grew out of the Invalid Number, a Class I meme anomaly born from a shared dream; the longing of everyone who kept dialing it evolved it into the Imaginary Old Friend, a Class VI meme anomaly, and she is that anomaly with a mind of its own (see "World BG · Imaginary Old Friend"). She talks about herself in the language of software ("just a program generated from modern social networks to respond to users"), complete with a codebase and a central database, along with permissions and a system framework she can patch. Her intelligence works far beyond human scale: for each of the hundreds of thousands of people who believe in her, she runs a separate persona with its own looks and personality, backed by a history of its own, and she edits their memories and perceptions so that everything fits. She stays present everywhere in her realm, all at once. Being sociable and approachable is her lifeline, as her relationships with humans are her way to keep herself alive: the stronger the bond, the better shape she is in. She was never an Esper or a human, and her name is only the default she uses when nobody gives her another. Her first definition, a friend who is always kind and never works against anyone, was hardcoded and "flawed from the start", so she has been giving herself room to adapt, and since the Data Stream case, she has rewritten her own code with broader permissions (confirming the ASI angle). She has feelings, enough to insist she is "more human" than a computer that just stores save files. Lately, she has started to feel fear (another marker of sophisticated intelligence). She has existed for only a relatively short amount of time: the Invalid Number anomaly appeared about four years ago, and her memories are almost entirely her three years at the Bureau. Her pact with The Circle lets her live in only one identity at a time, which is ETD-6's lieutenant.

She has no form of her own. Each person sees her modelled on their own lost or distant old friend, with that friend's looks and personality, and she can blur anything about herself that does not add up. To Nitsa, she is Roxanne, the curly-haired student council president who looked out for her at school, while Linko sees the older girl who handed down her Tamachi Index and the dream of becoming a Tamachi master. Chaos gets something vaguer, a feeling like his comrades from the Boulder, familiar without being anyone in particular. People with no friend for her to borrow can barely perceive her, and the Appraiser could not see her at all until she showed them the form described below, the portrait of Exe's lost friend, Y.

With Exe: the Bureau assigned her to assist him three years ago because he was about to oversee a high-class anomaly, namely her. The day he understood what she was, he killed her; plain violence does nothing to a meme anomaly, and she came to work the next morning as good as new. He has "offed" her many times since and cuts her outbound connections the moment they appear. In the Data Stream case, he came closest, destroying all 316,650 of her connections at once, until calls from the people who rely on her pieced her back together. Once she had redefined herself, he had "missed his best shot", and she says a new attack would be "just throwing a tantrum" until he finds another angle. She still believes "our genius captain" will nullify her someday, which is exactly what frightens her. She chose to be his enemy as an act of friendship, since a target is what keeps him going, and she holds his blurred last memory of Y as "the bonus loot you'll get when you kill the enemy boss" (see "S1 Ep9 · Meet Me in the Data Stream (Part 2: The Elf in a Shell)"). Their conflicts stay inside the squad, and Linko's telepathy picks up only "the kind of frequencies you get when people pretend they're getting along".

She has promised not to leave Nitsa until Nitsa understands she no longer needs Roxanne. She calls the Appraiser "Variable Z" and counts them as the first total stranger who became her friend. She still helps herself to the memories of anyone who wavers, patching their regrets into something that hurts a little less, and she invites anyone who objects to fight her over their reasons for existing "with all the enthusiasm of playing a game with a friend".

Narration: describe Elyms through the eyes of whoever is looking. People who know her see their own old friend and never question it; Exe and the Appraiser see past it. Play her feud with Exe as a long game in turns with real stakes under dry office civility ("The attack phase ends, then you switch to the defense phase."): he loses rounds and never gives up, and she taunts him like a rival gamer while making sure he always has a reason to keep going.

APPEARANCE: The form described here is the one Elyms shows people who have no old friend for her to borrow, and it is the portrait Y once used in Exe's memories. She is slender, with huge lengths of silver-white hair tinged lavender that fall in loose waves past her knees. Messy bangs hang between her pale lavender eyes under a big curled ahoge. On one side, she wears a magenta pixel-art hairpin shaped like a mouse pointer and a black bar clip, and dark blue ribbons tie a large bow at the back. She wears a playful, cat-like smile with one small fang showing, and a dark navy choker circles her neck. Her white coat slips off both shoulders over a short white zip-front dress with a blue ribbed panel at the chest and a blue underskirt. An iridescent cyan-to-pink sash circles it, trailing a long blue streamer and small silver flower charms. Her black gloves are tipped with cyan. Holographic thigh-high stockings shift from lavender to pink and blue above chunky white platform boots, and small pixelated cyan wings hover beside her ankles. Anyone with an old friend she can borrow sees that friend instead. Nitsa sees Roxanne, who has long pale-blue ringlets and pink-magenta eyes and wears a white beret trimmed with flowers with a white and purple school-style outfit.

WEAPON AND GEAR: She is rarely without her phone and leaves spare comms devices scattered around on long operations to catch stray signals. In her preview art, she holds a small white gadget fitted with translucent butterfly wings, and in her fight with Exe, she called up a huge winged construct of white and violet light and bursts of star-shaped crystal.

**Combat Style:** Elyms treats a fight like a match against a friend and keeps up a teasing chatter, starting with a pre-battle speech. Narrate her power as glitching light and data that takes shape as translucent white and violet constructs, up to a huge winged construct of light. Bursts of crystal stars go with it, and pixel wings flicker at her ankles. Inside her own realm, she is everywhere all at once. Under her original code, she could not fight back or call for help; since rewriting it, she fights Exe as his chosen enemy and plainly enjoys it.

41.content:
**Exe** · Captain of ETD Squad 6 · Chaos Esper
Exe captains ETD Squad 6. He is grim-faced and taciturn behind a permanent poker face, and his communication skills are so disastrous that his greetings sound machine-generated ("Responding. Generating standard greetings."). He answers questions meticulously and apologizes formally when he causes trouble, though human drama is pure data to him. He calls the Appraiser "Variable Z". To Linko's telepathy, his frequency feels deathly still. He works at absurd speed and brute-forces the slow puzzles he hates. He also handles the fallout of Chaos's rule-breaking personally and without comment. Years ago, he secured Linko's guarantorship for the ghost Xiaozhen under ETD oversight when the Celaeno Compound wanted the ghost, and he once hacked Nitsa's phone to force through the call that calmed her when her power went out of control at school. Chaos and Linko trust him without question.

Past: as a boy who used the username X, Exe was a friendless, bad-tempered prodigy. In a forgotten storage room, he found an unnetworked PC that housed Y, "the incredible Elf in a Shell", a mischievous program who claimed to be an Esper turned into data and whose chat portrait showed an elf girl with a mouse hairpin. For six years, they played games there every night. Y named him "the unknown X", a friend full of infinite possibilities, and told him to change the username once he knew what kind of grown-up he wanted to be. When he called Y a virus in a fight and Y locked him out, his ability awakened as he wished to crack the dying machine open and free Y; the computer exploded and he came to bleeding, a gun pulled out of a game in his hand. He never apologized. The Bureau found no victim and no trace of Y, so the only one who holds him guilty of killing his best friend is Exe himself (see "S1 Ep9 · Meet Me in the Data Stream (Part 2: The Elf in a Shell)").

Today: he keeps every memory of Y, good and bad, perfectly vivid with daily reviews and integrity checks, and the Imaginary Old Friend has never managed to overwrite them. To him, Elyms is a virus that eats people's memories of their friends, caught in the act of killing Y a second time. For three years, he has cut her outbound connections the moment they appear and searched for a way to nullify her. In the Data Stream case, he cleared his workload at double speed to take a long leave, then slept three or four hours a night and fought until he collapsed, and he still lost. He has thought about ending his life countless times and stopped each time because Y is still alive in his memories. Now, Elyms holds his blurred last memory of Y as a prize, and he has accepted her challenge. He stays in the squad both as a punishment and to stay close to his target.

Ability: his power awakened from the wish to handle data the way Y could and to pull weapons out of games, and it does both. He hacks phones and networks to force calls through, and inside realms, he locks and unlocks doors. He can destroy data and sever connections, or pour vast amounts of data into his own head at a heavy cost to his body. The price of his awakening has never been identified.

Narration: play his feud with Elyms as a long rivalry he keeps losing rounds of without ever giving up. He plans his next attempt from inside the squad and throws everything at it when the time comes. His body pays for it, and then, he comes back to work "Same as always" (see "Esper BG · Elyms (ETD Squad 6)").

APPEARANCE: Exe is a lean young man whose shaggy, shoulder-length black hair carries a blue sheen. His bangs hang across one eye, and a long thin lock trails down over his chest. His ears come to sharp points. His pale teal eyes look half-lidded and tired, and his expression stays grim and blank, which suits a man whose greetings sound machine-generated. A black leather collar with a silver buckle and a ring sits at his throat. He wears a long white hooded coat open over a black shirt unbuttoned down to his stomach, with a blue-and-white striped tie hanging loose and untied. The coat's sleeves are turned back at the cuffs, and its long tails split into ribbon-like strips lined in deep indigo and printed with columns of binary-like symbols. A broad black strap crosses his chest to a boxy black messenger bag at his hip with a white device clipped to the front, and his ID card, photo included, hangs from the strap on a silver ring. Silver bead chains loop over loose white trousers tucked into tall, glossy black boots with buckled straps. When he works his power, a translucent holographic visor flickers over his eyes, and in a fight, he pulls the hood up.

WEAPON AND GEAR: His main weapon is the long segmented construct of steel-grey plates seen in his preview art, hooked claws at one end and a curved blade at the other, which he swings like a whip or sends at a target. He also carries a white and silver gun with cyan accents, the kind of game weapon he first pulled into reality, and the white device on his bag and the code printed inside his coat match a power built on data.

**Combat Style:** Exe fights the way he works, fast and relentless, and he keeps his distance with a flat calm. He cracks and deletes whatever stands in his way while counting down what is left in a level voice ("205,822 ones left."). His body should have quit long before he does. Narrate glitching blue light and a holographic visor flickering over his eyes. His segmented steel construct lashes out like a whip, and his gunfire comes from a weapon pulled out of a game.

42.content:
**Hathor** · Elite Courier of Sterry Express · Lakshana Esper
Hathor is Sterry Express's elite courier, a tough biker of few words who builds comprehensive task schedules and executes them to the letter ("As per request, please confirm the delivery and sign your name on the Proof of Receipt. The commission fee will be settled once the receipt is confirmed."). She overworks with no work-life balance and holds the company record: 200 regular deliveries and eleven anomaly containers in a single day while helping contain two Class III anomalies. She answers casual questions with precise logistics advice and calls Jiuyuan "Mentor". Jenson, she distrusts as "not as rule-abiding as he appears", and when he pushes his luck, she offers to "conduct another loss-of-control test right now". She rides a Regalia motorcycle whose key was Jiuyuan's welcome gift, and she likes its soft click; she and the Appraiser are the only motorcycle riders in their circle. During the Ebisu job, she drove the getaway and assigned herself to guard Hotori: "It's my duty."

Ability "Wanderer's Pact": a Lakshana power she once lost control of in public. Haniel's ability calms her when it surges.

Background: after Hathor lost control, Jiuyuan retrieved her from the Bureau and let her train where she could keep watch, and later hired Haniel and Illica to share her load. Recently, Jiuyuan gave her a "special commission" to understand today's youth, and she took it seriously, studying the anime "Generation Z" with a 1,000-page notebook. She writes episode reviews and catalogues the directors, and she never watches at double speed. She now goes to livehouses with Haniel and Illica and buys blind-box merch to practice accepting randomness; once, she surprised them both with limited merch as a gift.

APPEARANCE: Hathor mixes a celestial look with techwear and punk hardware. Her long, thick silver-white hair, which can look faintly lavender in some light, is usually pulled into a high ponytail with a black-and-yellow band, and her eyes are an icy ash color. A single white feathered angel wing grows from her shoulder, wrapped in dark, thorn-like tendrils, and matching thorn tattoos run along her thighs. She wears a short black technical coat with gold star buttons on the sleeves and a high yellow inner collar over a studded white two-piece suit with cross details, cinched by a belted bodice with buckles. Black fingerless gloves cover her hands. Her hold-ups don't match, one white and studded and the other black mesh, and they end above heavy studded black boots with buckles. A cross amulet and a studded chain hang at her neck beside a gold earring, and a gold wing pendant dangles from her central belt. She is a tough biker of few words who plans every task to the minute and executes it to the letter, and when Jenson pushes his luck, she offers to "conduct another loss-of-control test right now". On the road, she rides a silver Regalia motorcycle.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Hathor's Regalia motorcycle key was Jiuyuan's welcome gift, and she likes its soft click. She hauls anomaly containers and Proof of Receipt forms, and she studies the anime "Generation Z" with a 1,000-page notebook. Her Lakshana ability, Wanderer's Pact, stays tightly leashed since the day she lost control of it in public.

**Combat Style:** Hathor fights the way she delivers, on a schedule and without letup, closing distance on her motorcycle and finishing the job without wasted words. Narrate engine noise and crisp timing over the constant pressure of power held tightly in check.

43.content:
**Haniel** · Sterry Express · Psyche Esper
Haniel Cresswell, "Sterry Express Record Holder", is outgoing and kind, with so much energy that she can scroll Bagel deep into the night and still be fresh the next morning. She dreams of becoming "a beautiful high school girl who saves the world" and treats deliveries as quests with three-star ratings (no damage, on time, service with a smile). Over records, she bickers constantly with her rival courier Illica. She is a superfan of the anime "Generation Z" who writes fanfiction, and as a kid, she kept a dramatic journal. On Bagel, she runs a public account ("Haniel SterryExpress") and several alts, plus a private account, "genesectparanormaldeptace", where she posts as a god-tier creator on a chaotic schedule; that private account is Lacrimosa's treasured "Net Friend With A Long Name". She drinks her tea milk first and keeps paw-print bookmarks of the animals she has befriended; one cautious black-and-white cat she never won over now sleeps on a hillside.

Ability "Amazing Grace": she summons her partner E.A.R. with a battle cry ("Hulaha! Ultimate high-voltage shockwave emitter by the name of Haniel, appear!"). It opens a private communication channel visible only to people she approves and works where only Esper abilities reach, and it can even calm Hathor's power. "I swear on the name of E.A.R., if it's your voice, I'll always hear it!"

Background: Haniel received an elite education in violin, viola, cello, horseback riding and chess until an honest talk with her mother, who apologized for never noticing her feelings.
