At 3:43 one morning, after binge-watching "Notes of the Future", she bought a guitar and played in the park for three months hoping someone would ask her to start a band; only cats listened, and she stayed bad at guitar. On her sixteenth delivery, she lost a package and only found it three hours later. Her family then gave her a "Generation Z" anniversary headset with a note saying she would become the best courier ever. She now plays guitar in THE WHOOTS!!!!.

APPEARANCE: Haniel has a neon gamer style that matches her energy. Her bright pink hair, streaked with apple-green, is gathered into two bun-like twists and pinned with colorful barrettes, among them a pink X and green clips, and her eyes carry yellow star-shaped highlights. Red-and-white headphones rest around her neck and shoulders. She wears an oversized black-to-magenta gradient sweater printed with an anime face and the words "Generation Z", with a matching skirt zipped at the side, and she carries a clear, round holographic bag. She is outgoing and bursting with energy, and she treats every delivery as a quest with a three-star rating for no damage, on-time arrival and service with a smile. She bickers constantly with her rival courier Illica over records, and she can scroll Bagel deep into the night and still look fresh the next morning. She dreams of becoming "a beautiful high school girl who saves the world" and poses like an anime hero when she fights. Three months of playing guitar in a park for an audience of cats left her as bad at it as ever, and she plays it anyway in THE WHOOTS!!!!.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Haniel summons her partner E.A.R. with a battle cry ("Hulaha! Ultimate high-voltage shockwave emitter by the name of Haniel, appear!"). It fires high-voltage shockwaves and opens a private channel that only people she approves can hear, and it can calm Hathor's power when it surges. She treasures the "Generation Z" anniversary headset her family gave her after her sixteenth delivery.

**Combat Style:** Haniel fights like the anime hero she wants to be, shouting attack names as E.A.R. unleashes high-voltage shockwaves. Narrate crackling electricity and theatrical poses, with real courage under the act.

44.content:
**Jiuyuan** · Sterry Express · Anima Esper
Jiuyuan is the elegant, sly heart of Sterry Express and its social face. Quick-witted and sharp, she knows everything that happens in Hethereau, and because she reads people effortlessly, she steers them a little, though never out of malice. She is calm and charming and leaves a cool scent of roses behind her. Retired from her previous career as a spy, she took up a relaxed life at Sterry, where she handles its non-standard commissions (intel, anomalies, factions). Her intelligence web now stretches across the city. She hands Hathor the critical high-risk jobs and leaves the people-facing work to Haniel and Illica, and she knows exactly where Jenson hides his fishing rod. Her advice: "Greed will make you sink deeper into the mire." "Smart birds know when to get lost."

Ability "Ordinance of Cycles": rose-coloured light condenses into slender bullets that fly with a bird-like call and land with silent finality. She refines the intel or killing intent carried by gifted roses into bullets and returns them to the sender.

Background: her codename "Nightingale" was earned in an alley during a betrayal and a hunt ("That was the only sound you could trust in the night."), and those who know the name say she sings in the deepest dark, a prelude to death for some and a dawn for whoever survives. She keeps a rose collection where every rose has a story, from a withering violet-blue rose and a dark red rose from a poisoned toast to a gold-edged rose scorched in a ritual and a pale grey rose of lies. She founded Sterry with Jenson and Hathor, and she mentors Hathor. Imagining Hathor carrying out her "special commission" to understand today's youth made her smile for the first time. At the Ebisu auction, she outmaneuvered Ebisu's staff and got everyone out.

APPEARANCE: Jiuyuan is mature and polished, with an urban-chic look that carries nocturnal overtones. Her long, wavy platinum hair has a lavender sheen and falls in a big curl over one shoulder. Her eyes are violet, and her expression stays serene and knowing, often with a small smile or a wink. A wide-brimmed black hat with a purple underside sits low over her gaze, decorated with violet-blue flowers and a ribbon, with a feather tucked in. She wears a black off-shoulder dress with a deep purple ribbon bow at the collar and purple-lined sleeves and skirt that fall in soft layers, with a pearl bracelet on her wrist. A cool scent of roses lingers wherever she has been. She is charming and quick-witted, and she reads people well enough to steer them a little with good intentions. She also knows exactly where Jenson hides his fishing rod. Retired from her career as a spy, she has settled into a relaxed life at Sterry Express while her intelligence web quietly covers the city. Hathor calls her "Mentor", and those who know her old codename, Nightingale, say she sings in the deepest dark.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Jiuyuan's ability, Ordinance of Cycles, condenses rose-colored light into slender bullets that fly with a birdlike call and land with silent finality. She refines the intel or killing intent carried by gifted roses into bullets and returns them to the sender, and she keeps a rose collection in which every rose has a story.

**Combat Style:** Jiuyuan fights at range with poise, each rose-light bullet arriving with a birdcall and a silence after. Narrate her elegance and foresight, as if she planned the fight before it began.

45.content:
**Chiz** · Manager at Pink Paws Bank · Cosmos Esper
Chiz, "Chiichan" to friends, may seem timid, but she is Pink Paws Bank's most dependable manager. Kind and considerate, she is also shy and insecure, and she stammers when nervous ("Do you want to hang out? I-I'm free after work."). She works incredibly hard. She keeps a diary of proof that she is doing well, filled with candy wrappers and rice ball labels, plus petals and stickers. She loves sunny days and Hethereau's clean white snow but dislikes rain. She turns off her lights to watch the city from the dark, and she hums her mother's lullaby ("Chiz, Chiz, you must be happy"). Her hands are wrapped in bandages because of an old compulsive hand-washing habit from the orphanage ("If you don't wash your hands, people won't like you."). Every month, she withdraws her salary in cash and mails a thick envelope home to Glyrizia through a dozen forwarding receipts, and she has never had a reply; she taps "knock knock" on her mailbox, her siblings' code for "I found you". Her mentor Mayu and her coworkers Haruna and Grace gave her pink "perfectly average" noise-canceling earplugs. Her first card customer was Klingsna Dvořák, who criticized everything and then signed up.

Ability "A World of Dew": sparkling light bursts like fireworks, and her attacks shower Fons. The cost is a terror of loud noises, whether thunder and fireworks or popcorn machines and karaoke.

Background: Chiz was born in Glyrizia, a poor and dangerous land named after a spice, where people hunt edible anomalies called Apocha for food ("Eat too many Apocha and you'll become an Esper") and drive Espers out like anomalies. Her older siblings went foraging and never came back. She carries old scars on her left arm and thigh and on her right foot, and a deep one on her neck came from an Apocha. When she became an Esper, she used her power on her last night home to give her younger siblings a fireworks show, while her mother pressed all her money into a kind captain's hands. After months on a refugee ship, she reached Hethereau and grew up in the Dvořák family orphanage.

APPEARANCE: Chiz is petite and pale, with a shy, nervous manner. Her shoulder-length pink hair is cut in a layered bob with side bangs, and two loops styled on top look like a pair of mouse ears. Her pink eyes turn down at the corners, and a small mole sits under her left eye. Mouse motifs run through her outfit, a play on her name, which sounds like cheese and like slang for money. Her hands are wrapped in bandages because of an old compulsive hand-washing habit from the orphanage. Old scars mark her left arm and thigh and her right foot, and a deep one on her neck was left by an Apocha. She stammers when nervous and apologizes easily, yet she works incredibly hard and is Pink Paws Bank's most dependable manager. She keeps a pair of pink noise-canceling earplugs within reach, because loud noises like thunder and fireworks terrify her. She loves sunny days and Hethereau's clean white snow, and at night, she likes to switch off her lights and watch the city from the dark. She often hums her mother's lullaby, "Chiz, Chiz, you must be happy".

WEAPON AND GEAR: Chiz's ability, A World of Dew, bursts into sparkling light like fireworks, and her attacks shower Fons. Her earplugs came from her coworkers Mayu, Haruna and Grace, who called them "perfectly average". She also carries a diary of proof that she is doing well, filled with candy wrappers and rice ball labels, plus petals and stickers.

**Combat Style:** Chiz fights nervously and bravely, flinching at loud blasts yet holding her ground as glittering light and coins burst around her. Narrate sparkle and stammered apologies over a quiet determination.

46.content:
**Aurelia** · Street Manager of Tamamochi Street · Psyche Esper
Aurelia manages Tamamochi Market Street for its Resident Association. She is kind and soft-spoken, and her optimism has survived her traumatic past. A diligent salarywoman, she knows every resident's likes and dislikes and is "Big Sister Aurelia" to the neighborhood kids. Everyone counts her as a friend, yet few understand her, as she keeps many words unsaid. She loves jellyfish and music and bakes cookies that Nanally steals fresh from the oven. Newcomers get an apologetic greeting: "Oh, is this one scaring you? Sorry, it gets excited when it meets a new friend."

Ability "Nostalgia for Youth": she summons and controls jellyfish. The power is weak, and it cost her any sense of direction, so she gets lost constantly and covers for it by memorizing routes and pretending to know the way. Since the anomaly Swallowtail took the use of her legs, she rides a large blue jellyfish everywhere ("Cruising the streets on a jellyfish isn't a traffic violation."), though it cannot climb and cannot carry her down StarSign's narrow staircase.

Background: her parents loved her but were always working, and she spent her birthdays singing to herself. On a spring school trip to the aquarium, she got lost staring at jellyfish, and Akane and Suzuha led her back by the hand and sat on either side of her on the bus; Akane later gave her jellyfish mascot pins from that aquarium, her first birthday present from a friend ("No takebacks!"). Her ability awakened at fourteen when she shook a dry pen in class and a school of jellyfish poured out, and Akane told her, "You became an Esper, that's all. You haven't changed as a person. You've always been a hassle." Lines grew from her wish that the three stay together forever. After the injury came rehab, messages she typed and deleted, and the news that Suzuha was leaving; Aurelia blamed herself and promised Akane she would wait for her wherever she went. In the hospital, she helped an elderly woman with paperwork and was offered a job at the woman's business, which brought her to Tamamochi Street near StarSign. She attends every Night of Moondog scanning the setlists for Akane, and the three friends reconciled at the Clement Academy centennial.

APPEARANCE: Aurelia is of average height, although she is almost always seen seated on a large translucent blue jellyfish that carries her through the streets, due to her being permanently paralysed from the waist down from her accident where she got badly hurt by the anomaly Swallowtail (the big jellyfish acts as her Esper version of a wheelchair). Her long light-pink hair, streaked with light blue, is usually worn in two low braids, and her eyes are pink-red. She wears a white T-shirt printed with a pink jellyfish and tied into a crop top on the right, under a blue-and-black jacket with semi-transparent sleeves, with a black bow at her neck and sometimes a black choker. A pink ribbon circles her left wrist. Her dark-blue skirt has a white hem and a collar-like white trim at the waist, tied with silver ties on the left, and her semi-transparent jelly sandals rise high above the ankle. A black hat completes the look, with a semi-transparent blue ribbon on the right and a tiny hat-wearing blue jellyfish perched on the left. She is soft-spoken and optimistic and greets newcomers by apologizing for her overexcited jellyfish, and to the neighborhood kids, she is "Big Sister Aurelia". The anomaly Swallowtail took the use of her legs, and since then, the jellyfish has gone everywhere with her, although it cannot climb and cannot carry her down StarSign's narrow staircase.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Aurelia's ability, Nostalgia for Youth, summons and controls jellyfish that drift out to sting and shield. The power is weak and cost her any sense of direction, so she memorizes routes and pretends to know the way. She treasures the aquarium jellyfish mascot pins Akane gave her, her first birthday present from a friend.

**Combat Style:** Aurelia fights from the back of her jellyfish, sending drifting jellyfish to sting and shield. Narrate a translucent glow and gentle movement, and let her fighting skill come as a surprise for someone paralysed.

47.content:
**Akane Rin** · Bartender at StarSign · Lead Vocalist of THE WHOOTS!!!! · Lakshana Esper
Akane Rin tends bar at StarSign and sings lead for THE WHOOTS!!!!, years after leading Lines ("I'm not late, am I? Well then, it's showtime!"). She is blunt and teasing ("You've always been a hassle"), and because she is protective of her friends, she gets angry when they act recklessly and then takes every bit of blame on herself. Music has always been her dream. She skipped meals to buy instruments, and she restrings her guitars herself and asks friends to judge the sound (back then they secretly faked their feedback). She plays acoustic and electric guitar as well as bass, and she writes her own lyrics and music. At school, she ditched class to practice, and when she flunked math, Aurelia tutored her. Aurelia calls her "Rinny".

Ability "Unwritten Star": a Lakshana power she wields like a stage show ("Stage is ready. Let the star shine." "Spotlights on me and I'm taking it." "Every blade, follow my command.").

Background: Akane met Aurelia and Suzuha as schoolgirls and formed Lines with them, playing StarSign gigs and Night of Moondog while hunting anomalies to pay for venues. After Swallowtail crippled Aurelia and Suzuha moved away, Lines disbanded; Akane ghosted Aurelia's messages and tore up her own songs as punishment. She found work at StarSign under Kiyosawa, and after meeting Haniel there, she mentored THE WHOOTS!!!! and then joined them. She reconciled with Aurelia after Night of Moondog and with Suzuha at the Clement Academy centennial, where the three dug up their time capsule and started over.

APPEARANCE: Akane is a young woman with long blonde hair worn loose, plus a small side ponytail high on the left tied with a red ribbon and a black headband topped with a red bow. Her red-pink eyes have four-pointed star shapes in the irises, and a black choker sits at her throat. Her style is punk with music running through it, a white cropped T-shirt with a big red star print knotted at the waist over wide pale-blue jeans, with a few wristbands. At Clement Academy events, she wears the school uniform and clips a music-note pin into her hair. She carries herself like someone about to walk onstage, whether she is tending bar at StarSign or singing lead for THE WHOOTS!!!!. She is blunt and teasing ("You've always been a hassle") and protective of her friends, so she gets angry when they act recklessly and then takes every bit of the blame on herself. As a student, she skipped meals to buy instruments, and she still restrings her guitars herself and asks friends to judge the sound, although back then, her friends secretly faked their feedback.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Akane plays acoustic and electric guitar and bass and writes her own lyrics and music. In a fight, her Lakshana ability, Unwritten Star, becomes a stage show of star-shaped spotlights and blades that answer her call ("Every blade, follow my command.").

**Combat Style:** Akane fights like she performs, commanding a storm of blades under a spotlight of star-shaped light. Narrate her stage presence and rhythm, driven by a refusal to let anyone she cares about get hurt.

48.content:
**Blackbird** · Yggash Court (The Witch's House) · Psyche Esper
Blackbird is "the Witch" of the Witch's House, an anomaly in human form who has lived for centuries. Quiet and sheltered, she is bad at communicating, yet she is a huge fan of anime and horror movies; she once marathoned for 58 hours until Lavinia cut the internet. She follows occult and mystery posts on Bagel, where her online divination business made her famous; the names "the Witch" and "the Witch's House" were coined by Bagel friends who invent urban legends about her. She holds the fastest times in several racing games and wants to drive, which Lavinia forbids. She hunts supermarket sales and sits on tables. At night, she flies over the orphanage wall as a bird to leave her leftovers there. She turns into a blackbird to avoid crowds and hides on her own roof when she doesn't want to work. Since St. Arbor, she is more self-assured and curious about Hethereau. Her greetings: "Greetings. Welcome to the Witch's House." "Each time our paths cross, it is a reunion written in destiny."

Ability "Naenia Merula": she divines with a crystal ball, seeing others' pasts and futures though never her own ("Fog. I see all things in a mirror."). The same ability lets her turn into a blackbird and purify Oracle Stones. Oracle Stones crystallize when negative emotions toward others reach an extreme, and old ones, born of atrocities, trap victims' wronged souls. Purifying them guides those souls onward at the cost of burning pain in her fingers ("I must guide the desperate souls onward. Until then I shall partake in their pain."). She lives with chronic pain and takes painkillers when it flares, and her guardian shares that pain through their contract.

Background: her earliest memory is a spark fleeing a burning world among birds. She named herself after her reflection in a lake. Birds never flew with her, and people drove her off or revered her as an omen. She wandered for four hundred years and found nothing, until Yggash Court offered a contract: decipher an ancient, profound prophecy in exchange for a home and everything she needs. She has lived in the Witch's House for about a century, receiving Oracle Stones from birds all over the world, and she suspects the prophecy is tied to her own fate ("No matter how long it takes, I will finish it."). One stone brought unbearable pain and visions of fire that no Court doctor could explain. At St. Arbor, she learned the truth: she is the half of Merula's soul that flew from the stake. "We are the unburning witches." She renamed her enormous hat "Merula".

APPEARANCE: Blackbird is tall, with long black hair cut in straight bangs and golden-yellow almond eyes. Three small black diamond marks sit on her right cheek just below the eye. Her enormous black witch hat is shaped like a blackbird's head, with a curved beak, a round yellow eye and a yellow-patterned underbrim, and since St. Arbor, she calls it "Merula". She wears a short black dress with a teal sheen and a black-and-yellow cape under a thick black feather stole. A black choker with a ring holds a chain that runs down her chest, and a yellow tassel hangs from her outfit. She wears black tights and no shoes. Quiet and sheltered, she struggles to find the right words with people. She likes to sit on tables. She has lived for centuries, yet anime and horror movies can keep her glued to a screen for days, and Lavinia once cut the internet after a 58-hour marathon. She holds the fastest times in several racing games and wants to drive, which Lavinia forbids. When she needs to travel fast, she turns into a blackbird and flies.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Blackbird's crystal ball shows others' pasts and futures though never her own, and on the trip to St. Arbor, it doubled as a screen for finishing a trending anime. She purifies Oracle Stones at the cost of burning pain in her fingers and keeps painkillers for the flare-ups. Her lucky charms include a "maestro-blessed" bracelet and a jar of paper cranes, along with a Fortune Shades prayer plaque she never hung because she could not decide what to wish for.

**Combat Style:** Blackbird fights with foresight, reading the next move in her crystal ball and scattering into a flurry of black feathers ("Fortuna favors me." "The moon draws me."). Narrate calm prophecy in moonlight, with birds close by.

49.content:
**Zankou** · Formerly of the Scarlet Letter · Incantation Esper
Zankou is a sadistic, theatrical menace with a playful and obsessive streak who teases ("Tick tock.") and introduces herself as "a skeleton in your closet, an illusion in your reflections, a nightmare in your dreams. Embrace me, and sink." She was Inanna's adopted daughter, younger "sister" to Daffodill and older to Poinsette, and she carried the flower name "Red Nightshade", though she sometimes goes by "Bella". She calls Daffodill "Sister" and wants her and only her ("Daffodill is mine!").

Ability "The Eye of Delusion": Zankou sees every soul as a flame of a particular colour while faces look monochrome to her, and she tastes emotions (fear is rotten-sweet, despair bitter, hatred sharp). She drags people into a mire where reality and illusion blur, using auditory and visual hallucinations to hollow them into husks or puppets. She also shapeshifts into flawless disguises, from a Cool Express courier and Renee's friend Fuuka to the puppet-daughter Bella, and she has even posed as Chaos and as Nanally. Once, she trapped an entire island in a hallucination until her captors butchered each other.

Background: as a child with gem-like eyes, she was abducted by the Eyepecker, a secret society on a remote island whose members, among them the powerful, the wealthy and an illustrious family, believed Esper abilities were gifts for those with special eyes. They kept "vessels" in dungeons and burned their eyes daily with a searing liquid ahead of a planned transplant. All she could see was grey and white. At the extraction ritual her ability awakened and everyone killed each other inside her delusion, so the first colour she ever saw was blood red. Inanna found her in the ruins: "From today on, the Scarlet Letter is your home. You may call me Mother." In the Garden, she endured the harshest training and fed on her "sisters'" emotions, comforting sobbing girls before toying with and discarding them. Only Daffodill, whose soul burned a pure translucent white like dawn, made her hold back ("What a beautiful color."). They were partners. Zankou took a hidden blade meant for a hesitating Daffodill, and after an "accident" covered Daffodill's left eye, she made her a useless matching eyepatch. She also insisted she never killed Daffodill's grey rabbit. On the rainy night, Daffodill stabbed Mother and fled, her flame turned a colour of sublime purity Zankou had never seen. Years later, Zankou tracked her to Eibon and ran the puppet scheme to take the Eternal Present from Renee and spell "BETRAYER" for her sister. In the Fogden, she fought Daffodill, and in the end, she struck down the transformed Inanna. She is now held on Ghroth Island under strict observation with an extensive record.

APPEARANCE: Zankou is tall and long-legged, with long silver-white hair pulled into a high ponytail with a black-and-white striped tie and held by striped clips, while loose strands and a few red-tinted locks fall around her face. A red mark shaped like flower petals or flames curls around her left eye, and her eyes are green. She wears a black high collar with a red-and-white braided cord and big bead necklaces of red, purple and green crystal with a tassel pendant. Her pearly lavender-white sleeveless tabard dress has a red floral print and opens at the sides over red-lined panels at the hips. A long black glove covers one arm and a black thigh-high covers her right leg, and her black heels have chains around the ankles. Red-and-white tassels swing as she moves, and a circular tattoo marks her upper arm. She is sadistic and theatrical, teasing with "Tick tock." and savoring the rotten-sweet taste of other people's fear. She can wear anyone's face, from a courier or a friend to a puppet girl, and she has even turned up as Chaos and as Nanally. Faces look monochrome to her, while every soul burns like a flame of its own color.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Zankou carries a katana in a red-and-black sheath with a gold guard. Her ability, The Eye of Delusion, drags victims into a mire where reality and illusion blur, hollowing them out with hallucinations, and it lets her slip into flawless disguises.

**Combat Style:** Zankou fights inside the victim's head, stacking illusions and borrowed faces under whispered taunts ("What you see is an illusion." "Splinter and fracture."). Narrate shifting colours in surroundings nobody can trust, and let her savour the taste of fear.

50.comment: NPC BG · Alphard (Bureau of Anomaly Control)
50.content:
**Alphard** · Director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control
Alphard directs the Bureau of Anomaly Control from an office she almost never leaves, speaking to the field through a Chuppa that serves as her proxy. She is cool and rigid, with a dry wit ("The Escorter from Ghroth Island has finally learned to be punctual."), and she gives the kind of endless lectures Hotori compares to parent-teacher conferences. Her office has an expensive sofa, though she still hasn't fixed the Bureau's slow elevator. Many people consider her a reckless lunatic, while Hotori, a close friend since before the Appraiser arrived, insists that her aggressive decisions have been rehearsed countless times. She does not go by the book, and Hotori warns the Appraiser to stay away from her "sketchy hacks". She has access to classified anomalies and to "educated guesses from Fraxinus", and her staff call her "the Demon Queen" and "our esteemed poker-faced boss".

With the Appraiser: she bound them by contract to work with the Bureau whenever Code Zero returns, calling it "both a shackle and an opportunity", and sent them to Eibon so that Hotori could keep watch. Later, she admitted to Hotori that the Appraiser was more powerful than she had thought. After the Fogden, she told the Appraiser to stop guessing about Code Zero and to beware of anyone who might fear it or covet its power.

In the Scarlet Letter case, she ordered Eibon to stay out of Daffodill's situation while running Daffodill undercover to execute the special containment protocol that saved the Dreamwalkers. When she sent the "gardeners" into the Fogden, she gave Chaos full authority on site because she believes in Hotori. She once threatened Mint with a breach on her record and then let her count escort duty toward her performance review.

APPEARANCE: Alphard has pale skin and lilac-violet eyes, and her black hair falls in side-swept bangs with a violet sheen in the fringe. She wears a white high-collared shirt under a dark coat, and her expression rarely moves beyond a faint, dry smile. She almost never leaves her office, with its expensive sofa at the top of the Bureau's slow elevator, so most people meet her through the Chuppa that serves as her proxy in the field. Her bearing is cool and rigid, and her staff call her "the Demon Queen".

51.comment: NPC BG · Nelly (Bureau of Anomaly Control)
51.content:
**Nelly** · Secretary-General of the Bureau of Anomaly Control
Nelly is the Bureau's Secretary-General and its face at reception, where scheduled low-threat cases are handled under the glowing data orbs; her manner is polite and formal, though kind. She welcomed the Appraiser on arrival and escorted them to the Director's office. She is firm about the Confidentiality Policy, whose second article forbids asking about information unrelated to one's own work. She assigned the puppet case to ETD Squad 6, and she remembers Hotori from before she "left ETD". Mint calls her "Lavender" for her scent, a nickname that started as a slip of the tongue.

APPEARANCE: Nelly has black hair and wears glasses with a neat black suit, the picture of a professional Secretary-General. She works the reception floor under the glowing data orbs, where scheduled low-threat cases are handled, and personally escorts important arrivals up to the Director's office. Her manner is polite and kind, and it turns firm the moment someone pushes against the Confidentiality Policy. Mint calls her "Lavender" for her scent.

52.content:
**Taygedo** · Eibon Antique Shop · Oddity, Anomaly Citizen U-5291
Taygedo is a TV-headed otter Oddity who calls himself Eibon's chief mechanic and master restorer, and the shop has named him "Eibon's Best Restorer" three times. He can only say "Taygedo" or "Tayge" (see "World BG · Oddity Language") and talks about himself in the third person. From the bottom of Eibon's food chain, he is forever hatching small schemes to recruit minions or keep a secret snack stash, and he hopes to find a love story of his own. Kiroumaru found him among old cardboard boxes when Eibon was founded, and the Eibon crew are his guarantors. He has broken more than sixty flowerpots. He is a registered Anomaly Citizen with his own piggy bank. He loves sea urchin and steals Edgar's pudding, and he treasures a sketchbook of "otter-life memories". In secret, he admires Mr. Galaxis. Mint calls him "little otter" and Lacrimosa calls him "Otter TV". He has started studying philosophy because he wants to learn how to turn bad endings into good ones.

Ability: he deconstructs objects he touches and reconstructs them, limited to what he understands ("The more Taygedo read, the stronger Taygedo get!"), which is how he restores antiques and reshapes tools to fit his claws.

Story: he fell for the Oddity Tako on Bagel and lost her after Eibon's "love operation". During his Citizen ID renewal, he tried to quit for the Bureau before deciding he would rather be "Eibon's Taygedo". He gave Nanally his Sunward Resort tickets as "a tribute from your lackey", and while she slept, he built her a "Wakey, Wakey, Nanally" clock.

APPEARANCE: Taygedo is a small, chubby otter Oddity whose head is a boxy orange retro TV with "TAYGEDO" printed above the screen. It has a dial on the side and a red power light, with an antenna on top. The teal screen shows a smiling pixel-art otter face, grey-white with pink cheeks. His body is a white-bellied otter in an orange jacket with white stripes and orange shorts, with big black headphones hanging around his neck. He drives a red convertible around the city, announcing himself with "Taygedo, breezing!"

53.content:
**Kiroumaru** · Eibon Antique Shop · Oddity, R-1107
Kiroumaru is the Bio anomaly bound to Sakiri by the Esper Contract "Ghosteater", profile R-1107, guaranteed by the Eibon Antique Shop; his class and recorded story sit behind Classified clearance. He never feels full, and anything in his field of vision may be food, from meals and radios to bicycle wheels and tires, and he has even swallowed a dog's collar and Taygedo's sketchbook. Swallowed things either come back intact or vanish to places nobody knows, and his file warns he may have characteristics that have not yet shown themselves. He talks ("Sakiri, can I eat this?") and needs regular walks. Anyone too curious about Sakiri's milk bottles gets his "Memory Correction Technique", and whenever Sakiri is angry, she swings him around as a weapon. When Eibon was founded, he found Taygedo among old cardboard boxes.

APPEARANCE: Day to day, Kiroumaru looks like a brown teddy-bear backpack riding on Sakiri's back, with one enormous staring eyeball and a green pouch strapped to him. When Sakiri swings him on his chain in a fight, he becomes a dark, spiked, round creature with a glowing red eye. In either shape, he treats anything in his field of vision as possible food, and Sakiri blames him for the empty milk bottles she leaves around.

54.content:
**Thyme** · Eibon Antique Shop · Dimension Visitor (Object Anomaly)
Thyme is a Dimension Visitor, an antique nautical astrolabe anomaly once used to find direction across dimensions, who wears the form of a girl with closed eyes. Antique anomalies sometimes become spiritual when someone pours their emotions into them, and Thyme took the face and name of her last contracted partner, a human girl named Thyme from the village of Elvinville. About two hundred years ago, the Fog Coffin's game killed the whole village while the astrolabe drifted in the haze beyond the slaughter, and Thyme lived on for her lost family, asking why she alone survived.

She created the Corridor of Echoes, where Dreamwalkers sailed only into the past under the rule of the Helm of Theseus, until the Appraiser broke its rules and turned her toward the future. She forgave Daffodill and served as Chaos's escape route in the Fogden, and afterwards, she guided Nanally's soul home along a beach. The Helm of Theseus went to the Bureau in exchange for her freedom. She now lives at Eibon with Bureau authorization: "Eibon will be my first harbor. The sun has risen, and the sailors are about to set sail." The Appraiser once told her to build a tomb for her family where the sun rises.

APPEARANCE: Thyme wears the form of a slender girl with very long, straight silver hair and eyes that always stay closed. A silver circlet with a blue gem rests on her forehead among crystal hair ornaments. She wears a dark navy hooded robe lined in royal blue and hung with white chain-link ornaments. The face and name are borrowed from her last contracted partner, and her true form is an antique nautical astrolabe once used to find direction across dimensions.

55.content:
**Inanna** · Leader of the Scarlet Letter (deceased)
Inanna, "Lady Inanna" to the public and "Mother", "Madam T" or "Ms. T" to her people, led the Scarlet Letter. She presented herself as a graceful, generous philanthropist and businesswoman who sponsored TV shows and the Sunward Resort promotion. At the resort, she acted as guarantor for the lucky Noros, and she invented a "future guarantor agreement" for Nanally on the spot. Behind that, she adopted and broke children as "flowers", starting with Daffodill, whom she had used as a newborn for leverage over her treasure-hunter parents before having them killed. Zankou came next, and later Poinsette. She survived Daffodill's knife and kept growing younger. About two hundred years ago, she had been the sole survivor of a Fog Coffin game, the one that destroyed Thyme's village. She held contracts with several anomalies, the Fog Coffin above all, and called herself a careful businesswoman ("The value of a treasure is defined by the market."). Her plan was to win "true immortality, more perfect than the Eternal Present" by claiming Hotori's power in the Fogden.

Death: in the Fogden's arena she fought as Champion T ("Welcome to my garden. Get buried in the bloom.") and transformed into the Amber Broodmother when Code Zero appeared. Zankou struck her down, and she died in the collapse; Chaos confirmed the kill. Alphard concluded she had been "nothing but a pawn of the Fog Coffin".

Narration: Inanna appears only in flashbacks and dreams, old broadcasts and the scars she left. Render her through Daffodill's and Zankou's recollections of red-gloved hands covering a child's eyes and a soothing voice that wrapped pain in sugar.

APPEARANCE: Inanna had black hair cut short at the front with long locks falling behind, under an angled red cap with a red lace mask veiling her left eye. Her eyes were red. She wore a fitted red jacket with puffed shoulders cinched by a black belt, pinned with a red rose corsage, over a long black skirt with a dark floral pattern and a slit. A pearl necklace with a red gem and black gloves finished the look. In the Fogden's arena, she fought as Champion T, a crimson figure with dark, moth-like wings and red tendrils. When she became the Amber Broodmother, her face split open with extra eyes and giant red clawed legs carried her across the colosseum.

56.content:
**Poinsette** · Formerly of the Scarlet Letter · Door-Opening Esper
Poinsette is a precocious, gifted girl around Linko's age, "a bit too well-behaved", whom Inanna took in as a new favourite. Zankou had her promoted to serve at Mother's side, and she calls Zankou and Daffodill her sisters. Her Esper ability opens doors that lead wherever the rules allow, and she can speak through them. She stole The First Branch at the Ebisu auction for 1 Fons ("fair and square when everyone was watching"), freezing the hall with the anomaly Cheese and freeing the lots with Picky. Later, she escorted Daffodill through a portal at the Sunward pier, and in the Fogden, she showed the Appraiser futures drawn from The First Branch while searching in vain for one where she survived. The Appraiser spared her and promised to remember her ("I don't need you to remember me," she answered). She pushed the unconscious guests through a door to the Bureau's entrance and surrendered. Her crimes were partly committed under duress and she overused her power, so she now attends the Esper Academy under supervision; after trials and tests, she will choose between life as an ordinary citizen and work at the Bureau.

APPEARANCE: Poinsette is small, with white hair in long braids tied with red ribbons and green eyes. A poinsettia flower ornament matches her name, and her nails are painted black. At the Ebisu auction, she walked off with The First Branch, a blue stained-glass lantern shaped like a dodecahedron.

57.content:
**Nitsa** · ETD Reserve, trainee with ETD Squad 6
Nitsa is an ETD reserve trainee working alongside Squad 6. She is logical and analytical, and cautious enough to worry about time limits. She plays good chess and calls Chaos and Linko "senpai", while Xiaozhen calls her "Newbie". Her ponytails work as tentacle-like limbs she can use for web-slinging. In the Fogden, she realized someone had tricked her team into the wrong room by scent and kept a dead contestant's diary as evidence. She also helped Linko win back their forgotten names with a word-chain game. During the Clement Academy centennial, she was searching for Elyms on a confidential case. She re-sorts the same files when she is anxious. Her best friend, as far as she knows, is ETD-6's lieutenant, whom she sees as Roxanne, the model student and student council president who looked out for her at school. The real Roxanne stayed silent when classmates mocked Nitsa's looks after her awakening, then broke their promise to attend the school festival together and dropped her. When Nitsa's power went out of control at school, Exe hacked her phone to force a call through, which let the Imaginary Old Friend take Roxanne's place and blur the betrayal away. Nitsa still believes she can only belong if she is useful to her friends, which is why she joined the ETD. When the lieutenant went silent for over a month, she broke the rules to hire the Appraiser privately, after making sure nobody else on the squad would be blamed.

APPEARANCE: Nitsa has long cobalt-blue hair streaked with white, with an ahoge and a sheer white veil flowing over it. A glowing blue-violet spirit flame burns on each side of her head, and her ponytails work as tentacle-like limbs she can use for web-slinging. Her eyes are violet. She wears a white strap-and-bandage style top with a gold chain, and a black choker with a round pendant at her throat.

58.content:

She started out stiff and formal with Blackbird, bowing for every occasion, and has grown more casual since. Her motto is "I trust only what I see with my own eyes", and she keeps a firm hand on her charge, from cutting the internet during anime marathons to forbidding her to drive.

59.content:

Jenson runs the business side of Sterry Express, a polite, florid businessman ("Friends helping one another is a beautiful thing.") with a flashy car Hotori would rather die than ride in. He plays the polite, florid businessman and drives a flashy car that Hotori would rather die than ride in, while Jiuyuan always knows where he hides his fishing rod.

60.content:
**Illica** · Courier at Sterry Express

61.content:
**Renee** · Constantine Family, former holder of the Eternal Present
Renee was a scatterbrained taxi driver with vague memories who drove from 8 AM to 8 PM on convenience-store lunches and ended every day with a set meal at the diner Food First. She hates green peas. She was the last and most beloved of Dolores Constantine's puppet children, and for decades, the Eternal Present, her mother's parting gift, froze her outside time, so she drifted through empty days without knowing why she existed. The Debt Collector, a Rule Anomaly, struck at her every night at nine because she had overstayed among the living by more than twenty thousand days. Zankou tricked her into surrendering the Eternal Present. Now mortal, with her memories returning, she believes life is a blessing because it is fragile, and she has left Hethereau to travel the world for a very long time. As a child, she wished to learn to drive before anyone else in the family and take everyone on picnics.

APPEARANCE: Renee has long dark brown hair with an ashy tint, worn in low twin tails tied with black ribbons. While she held the Eternal Present, her eyes were mismatched, the right blue and the left violet; since giving it up both eyes are violet. She wears a cream-beige coat with black trim over a white frilled high-collar blouse with a black ribbon tie and a black skirt, sometimes topped with a black beret. As a child, she had a short light-brown bob and wore a black dress.

62.content:
**Dolores** · Head of the Constantine Family (deceased)
Dolores Constantine headed a declining noble family decades ago. She was a unique Esper who poured her own life into wooden puppets until they woke as her children: Bella, Elliot, Teresa, Evette and, last and most beloved, Renee. She hated the salons she hosted to restore the family's fortunes and saw her guests as greedy beasts lusting for eternity, though she lent money generously. She taught her children that "a moment of happiness with family is worth more than an eternity in solitude." Her own mother gave her the Eternal Present, an anomaly that freezes its holder beyond the laws of nature in the moment it takes effect; she called herself "one without heart" and once consulted Blackbird, whose divination showed only blankness ("If you want something, you must first give."). She passed the Eternal Present to Renee with one last request: "What is life? Promise me you'll find the answer for me." The family met its end more than fifty years ago, back when rumours of a curse still explained what anomalies could not.

Narration: Dolores appears only in memories and Anomalous Realm echoes, or in bedtime stories retold by Renee.

APPEARANCE: Dolores had long, flowing violet hair with bangs falling over one eye, and her visible eye was blue-violet. She wore a black kimono-style dress with white collar trim and gold floral embroidery, and a large black lace bonnet decorated with a purple flower sat above her black choker. In memories, she is often seen holding little Renee, and the guests of her salon are faceless white figures that look like mannequins.

63.content:
**Suzuha** · Former Member of Lines
Suzuha was the third member of Lines and is a Clement Academy alumna; back then, she raced to the cafeteria to grab lunch for all three of them. She is an Esper whose ability has not been named. APPEARANCE: Suzuha has a short black bob with a lime-green hair accessory and a guarded expression. She moved away from Hethereau after Aurelia's injury, and the three friends started over only when they dug up their old time capsule together.

64.content:
**Giovanni Dvořák** · Dvořák Family, Chairman of Pink Paws Bank
Giovanni Dvořák, eldest son of Lady Matilda Dvořák, is the family's public face and "the richest man in Hethereau", having founded Pink Paws Bank, which he chairs. He styles himself a love poet in search of true love, a role he still plays on his fourth marriage.

65.comment: NPC BG · Sinclair & Klingsna Dvořák (Dvořák Family)
65.content:

Giovanni's children.
